baby.definition:
n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
n. the youngest member of a group (not necessarily young)
n. an unborn child; a human fetus
n. (slang) sometimes used as a term of address for attractive young women

examples.en: He saved the baby at the cost of his life.
examples.zh: 他救了那个婴儿，但是却牺牲了自己的生命。

examples.en: The baby seemed to be in a deep sleep.
examples.zh: 那个婴儿似乎在熟睡中。

examples.en: She had my mother take care of the baby.
examples.zh: 她让我母亲照顾孩子。

back.definition:
n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine
n. the part of something that is furthest from the normal viewer
n. (football) a person who plays in the backfield
n. the part of a garment that covers the back of your body
back.translation:
a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面

examples.en: I will be back to join you in one month.
examples.zh: 我会在一个月后回来和你们见面。

examples.en: I want you to stay here until I get back.
examples.zh: 我想你待在这里直到我回来。

examples.en: I know New York like the back of my hand.
examples.zh: 我对纽约了如指掌。

background.definition:
n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training
n. the part of a scene (or picture) that lies behind objects in the foreground
n. information that is essential to understanding a situation or problem
n. extraneous signals that can be confused with the phenomenon to be observed or measured
background.translation: n. 背景, 背景资料\n[计] 背景, 后台

examples.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
examples.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

examples.en: In the background of the picture is a castle.
examples.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

examples.en: Does your family background involve Chinese medicine?
examples.zh: 您的家族史跟中医有没有关系？

backward.definition:
a. directed or facing toward the back or rear
a. (used of temperament or behavior) marked by a retiring nature
s. retarded in intellectual development
s. having made less than normal progress
backward.translation: adv. 向后地, 相反地\na. 向后的, 相反的\n[计] 倒推

examples.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
examples.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

examples.en: Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.
examples.zh: 社会不是在进步，而是在退步。

examples.en: Tom took a step backward.
examples.zh: 汤姆后退一步。

bacon.definition: n. back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried\nn. English scientist and Franciscan monk who stressed the importance of experimentation; first showed that air is required for combustion and first used lenses to correct vision (1220-1292)\nn. English statesman and philosopher; precursor of British empiricism; advocated inductive reasoning (1561-1626)
bacon.translation: n. 熏猪肉\n[机] 腌肉

examples.en: BLT stands for bacon, lettuce and tomato.
examples.zh: BLT 代表培根、生菜和番茄。

examples.en: Would you like bacon or sausage?
examples.zh: 你要培根还是要香肠?

bacteria.definition: n. (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
bacteria.translation: pl. 细菌\n[医] 细菌, [无芽胞]杆菌

examples.en: There’s work and there’s your life’s work.
examples.zh: 有的工作只是工作，有的工作是你毕生的事业。

examples.en: Are we making a nonstop flight to the U.S.?
examples.zh: 我们是不是直飞美国？

examples.en: The capital of the U.S. is Washington, D.C.
examples.zh: 美国的首都是华盛顿。

bad.definition:
n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency
a. having undesirable or negative qualities
s. very intense
s. feeling physical discomfort or pain (`tough' is occasionally used colloquially for `bad')
bad.translation: a. 坏的\nn. 坏\nadv. 坏地

examples.en: There never was a good war nor a bad peace.
examples.zh: 战争永远谈不上好，和平永远谈不上坏。

examples.en: He is suffering from a bad cold in the nose.
examples.zh: 他患了重感冒。

examples.en: Why are you in such a bad mood this morning?
examples.zh: 你今天早上为什么心情这么差？

badge.definition: n. an emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)\nn. any feature that is regarded as a sign of status (a particular power or quality or rank)\nv. put a badge on
badge.translation: n. 徽章, 标记\n[计] 标记

examples.en: Some spaghetti fell on the badge of the uniform, dirtying it.
examples.zh: 有一些意面掉到了制服上的徽章那儿，把那边弄脏了。

examples.en: Stefan had to show his student ID badge.
examples.zh: 斯特凡必须出示学生证。

badly.definition:
r. to a severe or serious degree
r. evilly or wickedly
r. in a disobedient or naughty way
r. with great intensity (`bad' is a nonstandard variant for `badly')
badly.translation: adv. 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地

examples.en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
examples.zh: 我们这样待他，好像不是太好。

examples.en: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
examples.zh: 他为自己的行为感到非常羞耻。

examples.en: It's ached before, but never as badly as right now.
examples.zh: 痛过，但是没现在这么厉害。

bag.definition:
n. a flexible container with a single opening
n. the quantity of game taken in a particular period (usually by one person)
n. a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)
n. the quantity that a bag will hold
bag.translation: n. 袋子, 袋状物\nvt. 使膨大, 装袋, 猎获

examples.en: Why do children have to carry such a heavy bag?
examples.zh: 为什么小朋友得背这么重的书包呢?

examples.en: Mary claimed the bag was a gift from her husband.
examples.zh: 玛莉表示，包包是丈夫送的礼物。

examples.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
examples.zh: 我不该把一整包薯片都吃完的。

baggage.definition: n. cases used to carry belongings when traveling\nn. a worthless or immoral woman\nn. the portable equipment and supplies of an army

examples.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?
examples.zh: 请问您有多少件行李？

examples.en: Please take that baggage to the post office.
examples.zh: 请将这些行李拿到邮局那边。

examples.en: Don't carry too much baggage when you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行时不要带太多行李。

bake.definition: v. cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven\nv. prepare with dry heat in an oven\nv. be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun
bake.translation: vt. 烘焙, 烤\nvi. 烤面包\nn. 烘焙, 烤

examples.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房有烤箱，可以用来烤面包。

examples.en: Ziri needs baking soda to clean his kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 齐里需要小苏打，用来清洁他的厨房水槽。

examples.en: Egg tarts, when freshly baked, are a real delicacy.
examples.zh: 新鲜出炉的蛋挞味道一流。

balance.definition:
n. a state of equilibrium
n. equality between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account
n. equality of distribution
n. the difference between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account
balance.translation: n. 平衡, 差额\nvi. 平衡, 相等\nvt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消

examples.en: Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.
examples.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。

examples.en: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.
examples.zh: 在结冰的街道上我们很难保持平衡。

examples.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
examples.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。

balcony.definition: n. an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium\nn. a platform projecting from the wall of a building and surrounded by a balustrade or railing or parapet
balcony.translation: n. 阳台, 戏院楼厅

examples.en: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
examples.zh: 一家人在阳台上吃早饭。

examples.en: Why don't you go out on the balcony and get some sun?
examples.zh: 去阳台上晒晒太阳怎么样？

examples.en: What are you doing on the balcony?
examples.zh: 你在阳台上做什么？

ball.definition:
n. round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games
n. an object with a spherical shape
n. the people assembled at a lavish formal dance
n. a spherical object used as a plaything
ball.translation: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物\nv. 捏成球形

examples.en: Seen from the moon, the earth looks like a ball.
examples.zh: 从月球上看的话，地球看起来像个皮球。

examples.en: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
examples.zh: 我请这个男孩把球扔回来。

examples.en: Jake quickly threw the ball in to his teammate.
examples.zh: 杰克快速掷界外球给他的队友。

ballet.definition: n. a theatrical representation of a story that is performed to music by trained dancers\nn. music written for a ballet

examples.en: My husband and I are going on Sunday to see the ballet, Carmen, performed by the National Ballet Company at the Four Seasons Centre.
examples.zh: 我和丈夫周日要去四季演艺中心，去看国家芭蕾舞团表演的芭蕾舞剧《卡门》。

balloon.definition:
n. large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air
n. small thin inflatable rubber bag with narrow neck
v. ride in a hot-air balloon
v. become inflated
balloon.translation: n. 气球\nvt. 使成气球状\nvi. 膨胀如气球, 激增

examples.en: The balloon was caught in the tree.
examples.zh: 这颗气球被树绊住了。

examples.en: Tom is inflating a balloon.
examples.zh: 汤姆在吹气球。

ballot.definition: n. a document listing the alternatives that is used in voting\nv. vote by ballot
ballot.translation: n. 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签\nvi. 投票, 抽签\nvt. 投票选出, 拉选票

examples.en: At a time when women's voices were silenced and their hopes dismissed, she lived to see them stand up and speak out and reach for the ballot. Yes, we can.
examples.zh: 妇女当时没有投票权，她们的希望被挫败，但是安-尼克松-库波尔活着看到妇女们站了起来，看到她们站出来发表自己的见解，看到她们参加大选投票。是的，我们能做到。

bamboo.definition: n. the hard woody stems of bamboo plants; used in construction and crafts and fishing poles\nn. woody tropical grass having hollow woody stems; mature canes used for construction and furniture

examples.en: In spring, the bamboo grove outside Hsinchu City is especially green.
examples.zh: 春天的时候，新竹城外的竹林特别翠绿。

examples.en: There's bamboo growing in the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里有竹子在生长。

examples.en: Pandas feed on bamboo grass.
examples.zh: 熊猫以竹为食。

ban.definition:
n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Moldova
n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Romania
n. an official prohibition or edict against something
v. forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)
ban.translation: n. 禁令\nvt. 禁止, 取缔

examples.en: In the Netherlands they want to ban the Qur'an.
examples.zh: 荷兰有人想禁掉《古兰经》。

examples.en: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
examples.zh: 德国将禁止雇主在脸书上偷窥。

examples.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
examples.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

banana.definition: n. any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits\nn. elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh

examples.en: I observe a chimpanzee peel a banana and eat it.
examples.zh: 我观察到一只黑猩猩剥了一根香蕉并吃了它。

examples.en: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.
examples.zh: 光阴飞逝如箭; 果蝇喜欢香蕉。

examples.en: I have never fed my dog a banana.
examples.zh: 我从没给我的狗喂过香蕉。

band.definition:
n. instrumentalists not including string players
n. a stripe or stripes of contrasting color
n. an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material
n. a range of frequencies between two limits
band.translation: n. 带子, 队, 乐队\nv. 联合, 结合\n[计] 频带; 波段; 区

examples.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
examples.zh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。

examples.en: I got a disease from listening to that band.
examples.zh: 光是听那个乐团的歌就会染病。

examples.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
examples.zh: 有人认为他们是历史上最伟大的乐队。

bandage.definition: n. a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body\nv. dress by covering or binding
bandage.translation: n. 绷带\n[化] 帘布筒; 实心轮胎; 紧带; 绷带

examples.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
examples.zh: 护士轻柔地给我的头缠上绷带。

examples.en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
examples.zh: 他先清洗了伤口，再绑上绷带。

examples.en: He wound a bandage around the wound.
examples.zh: 他用绷带包扎了伤口。

bandwidth.definition: n. a data transmission rate; the maximum amount of information (bits/second) that can be transmitted along a channel
bandwidth.translation: n. 频带宽度, 通带宽度\n[计] 带宽, 频宽

examples.en: We don't have enough bandwidth to use that service.
I do not have the bandwidth to talk to you right now.
I accidentally used up all the bandwidth.

bank.definition:
n. sloping land (especially the slope beside a body of water)
n. a long ridge or pile
n. an arrangement of similar objects in a row or in tiers
n. a supply or stock held in reserve for future use (especially in emergencies)
bank.translation: n. 银行, 堤, 岸\n[医] 库

examples.en: This is a post office and that is a bank.
examples.zh: 这是邮局，那是银行。

examples.en: Go along this street and turn right at the bank.
examples.zh: 请沿着这条路走，在银行那里向右转。

examples.en: It's a good three kilometres from here to the bank.
examples.zh: 从这里到银行足有三公里路。

bankrupt.definition: n. someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts\nv. reduce to bankruptcy\ns. financially ruined
bankrupt.translation: n. 破产者\na. 破产的\nvt. 使破产

examples.en: The company went bankrupt. We laid off all of the employees.
examples.zh: 公司倒闭了。我们遣散了所有员工。

examples.en: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.
examples.zh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。

examples.en: The company will soon go bankrupt.
examples.zh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。

bankruptcy.definition: n. a state of complete lack of some abstract property\nn. inability to discharge all your debts as they come due\nn. a legal process intended to insure equality among the creditors of a corporation declared to be insolvent
bankruptcy.translation: n. 破产者\n[经] 破产, 倒闭

examples.en: Yanni is so broke he's on the verge of bankruptcy.
In Algeria, many businesses are on the brink of bankruptcy.
She almost took him to the edge of bankruptcy.

banner.definition: n. long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising\ns. unusually good; outstanding
banner.translation: n. 旗帜\na. 显著的, 特别好的

examples.en: The protesters threatened to stomp on the banners left by their opposition.
examples.zh: 抗议者威胁要践踏反对者留下的横幅。

banquet.definition: n. a ceremonial dinner party for many people\nn. a meal that is well prepared and greatly enjoyed

examples.en: Some Shanghainese hold large banquets when they get married.
examples.zh: 上海人结婚，有的人家办酒宴场面很大。

bar.definition:
n. a counter where you can obtain food or drink
n. a rigid piece of metal or wood; usually used as a fastening or obstruction or weapon
n. an obstruction (usually metal) placed at the top of a goal
n. (meteorology) a unit of pressure equal to a million dynes per square centimeter
bar.translation: n. 条, 棒, 酒吧, 栅, 障碍物\nvt. 禁止, 阻挡, 妨碍\n[计] 棒形图

examples.en: Did any cute girls talk to you at the bar?
examples.zh: 在酒吧有没有美女找你搭讪？

examples.en: If you sang, they'd kick you out of the bar.
examples.zh: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

examples.en: My friends and I often go to the bar.
examples.zh: 我跟我朋友常常去酒吧。

bare.definition:
v. lay bare
s. completely unclothed
s. lacking in amplitude or quantity
a. lacking its natural or customary covering
bare.translation: a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 无遮蔽的, 坦率的\nvt. 使赤裸, 露出

examples.en: It's hard to catch a rabbit with your bare hands.
examples.zh: 徒手逮兔挺难。

examples.en: It's difficult to catch a rabbit with your bare hands.
examples.zh: 徒手逮兔挺难。

examples.en: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
examples.zh: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。

barely.definition: r. only a very short time before

examples.en: The train is about to leave, we can barely catch it.
examples.zh: 火车马上就要开，我们勉强可以赶到。

examples.en: During droughts, farmers are barely able to eke out a living.
examples.zh: 发生旱灾的时候，农民很难维持生计。

examples.en: I just barely managed to pass the test.
examples.zh: 我差点没考过。

bargain.definition: n. an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each\nn. an advantageous purchase\nv. come to terms; arrive at an agreement
bargain.translation: n. 交易, 买卖协定, 特价商品\nv. 讲价, 交易

examples.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
examples.zh: 这场减价活动会持续三天，从今天开始。

examples.en: This dress is a good bargain.
examples.zh: 这条连衣裙很便宜。

examples.en: She's good at bargaining the price down.
examples.zh: 她很善于砍价。

bark.definition:
n. tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants
n. a noise resembling the bark of a dog
n. a sailing ship with 3 (or more) masts
n. the sound made by a dog
bark.translation: n. 树皮, 吠声\nvi. 吠, 叫骂\nvt. 喊出, 剥树皮

examples.en: A dog will bark at strangers.
examples.zh: 狗会对陌生人叫。

examples.en: I heard a dog barking in the distance.
examples.zh: 我听到远处传来狗叫声。

examples.en: Birch trees have white bark.
examples.zh: 桦树有白树皮。

barn.definition: n. an outlying farm building for storing grain or animal feed and housing farm animals\nn. (physics) a unit of nuclear cross section; the effective circular area that one particle presents to another as a target for an encounter
barn.translation: n. 谷仓\n[化] 靶(恩)(核反应截面单位)

examples.en: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.
examples.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。

examples.en: What's the difference between an eagle-owl and a barn owl?
examples.zh: 雕鸮和仓鸮有什么区别？

examples.en: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
examples.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。

barrel.definition:
n. a tube through which a bullet travels when a gun is fired
n. a cylindrical container that holds liquids
n. a bulging cylindrical shape; hollow with flat ends
n. the quantity that a barrel (of any size) will hold

examples.en: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.
examples.zh: 枪杆子里面出政权。

examples.en: Cookie's house is a laid barrel.
examples.zh: 曲奇的窝是一个平放的木桶。

examples.en: Wine is put in barrels to mature.
examples.zh: 酒被放在桶里发酵。

barrier.definition: n. a structure or object that impedes free movement\nn. any condition that makes it difficult to make progress or to achieve an objective\nn. anything serving to maintain separation by obstructing vision or access
barrier.translation: n. 障碍, 栅栏\n[化] 势垒; 阻片; 阻挡层

examples.en: Some birds can break the sound barrier.
examples.zh: 有的鸟可以穿越音障。

examples.en: Trade barriers were lifted after the war ended.
examples.zh: 战争结束之后贸易障碍被解除。

base.definition:
n. installation from which a military force initiates operations
n. a place that the runner must touch before scoring
n. the bottom or lowest part
n. (anatomy) the part of an organ nearest its point of attachment
base.translation:
n. 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地
vt. 以...作基础
a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的
[计] 基准

examples.en: Their wish is engraved on the base of the statue.
examples.zh: 他们的愿望被刻在雕像的底座上。

examples.en: This city lies at the base of a mountain.
examples.zh: 这座城市位于山脚下。

examples.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
examples.zh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。

baseball.definition: n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players; teams take turns at bat trying to score runs\nn. a ball used in playing baseball
baseball.translation: n. 棒球\n[计] 棒球系统

examples.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
examples.zh: 他喜欢看电视上的棒球比赛。

examples.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
examples.zh: 棒球比赛因为天雨取消了。

examples.en: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
examples.zh: 如果明天天气好，我们就去打棒球。

basic.definition:
n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use
n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant
a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality
basic.translation: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律\na. 基本的, 碱性的\n(计算机)BASIC语言

examples.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
examples.zh: 分支和合并是版本控制的两种基本操作。

examples.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
examples.zh: 这项法律会剥夺我们的基本权利。

examples.en: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
examples.zh: 汉字的基本单位称作「部首」。

basically.definition: r. in essence; at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature
basically.translation: adv. 基本上, 主要地

examples.en: Basically, I agree with your opinion.
examples.zh: 基本上我赞同你的意见。

examples.en: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
examples.zh: 有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。

examples.en: From what I understand, those who watch Korean soap operas basically are women with nothing to do.
examples.zh: 我了解的情况是看韩剧者基本上是一些无所事事的女人。

basin.definition: n. a bowl-shaped vessel; usually used for holding food or liquids\nn. the quantity that a basin will hold\nn. a natural depression in the surface of the land often with a lake at the bottom of it
basin.translation: n. 盆, 盆地\n[医] 第三脑室, 骨盆

examples.en: A student was run over by a car on Basin Street.
examples.zh: 有个学生在贝辛路被车轧了。

basis.definition: n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained\nn. the most important or necessary part of something
basis.translation: n. 基础, 主要成分\n[化] 基底

examples.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
examples.zh: 衣食住是生存的基础。

examples.en: We should judge matters on a broader basis.
examples.zh: 要有大局观。

examples.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
examples.zh: 这些主张没有科学的根据。

basket.definition:
n. a container that is usually woven and has handles
n. the quantity contained in a basket
n. horizontal circular metal hoop supporting a net through which players try to throw the basketball
n. a score in basketball made by throwing the ball through the hoop
basket.translation: n. 篮, 篮子\nvt. 装入篮

examples.en: There are a lot of eggs in the basket.
examples.zh: 篮子里有很多鸡蛋。

examples.en: A cat just came out of the basket.
examples.zh: 有只猫刚刚从篮子里爬了出来。

examples.en: She was carrying a basket full of flowers.
examples.zh: 她提着一只满是鲜花的篮子。

basketball.definition: n. a game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop\nn. an inflated ball used in playing basketball

examples.en: Two years ago I could not play basketball at all.
examples.zh: 两年前我完全不懂得打篮球。

examples.en: I like rugby, but not as much as I like basketball.
examples.zh: 我喜欢橄榄球，但不像我喜欢篮球那么喜欢。

examples.en: I've always wanted to be a professional basketball player.
examples.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

bat.definition:
n. nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings and anatomical adaptations for echolocation by which they navigate
n. (baseball) a turn trying to get a hit
n. a club used for hitting a ball in various games
v. strike with, or as if with a baseball bat
bat.translation: n. 蝙蝠, 球棒\nv. 用球棒打, 眨眼\n[计] 成批

examples.en: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.
examples.zh: 难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。

examples.en: The bats use ultrasound to locate obstacles.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠使用超音波来定位障碍物。

examples.en: Is that a bat?
examples.zh: 那是只蝙蝠吗？

batch.definition:
n. all the loaves of bread baked at the same time
n. (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
n. a collection of things or persons to be handled together
v. batch together; assemble or process as a batch
batch.translation: n. 一次所烘的面包, 一次所制之量, 一组, 批, 成批, 分批\nv. 成批, 分批处理\n[计] 一批

examples.en: The third batch of vaccines provided by China to Colombia has arrived in Bogota, the capital of Colombia.
examples.zh: 中国向哥伦比亚提供的第三批疫苗运抵哥伦比亚首都波哥大。

bath.definition:
n. a vessel containing liquid in which something is immersed (as to process it or to maintain it at a constant temperature or to lubricate it)
n. you soak and wash your body in a bathtub
n. an ancient Hebrew liquid measure equal to about 10 gallons
n. a town in southwestern England on the River Avon; famous for its hot springs and Roman remains
bath.translation: n. 沐浴, 浴室\n[医] 浴

examples.en: I was in the bath when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。

examples.en: Tom hasn't taken a bath in a long time.
examples.zh: 汤姆很长时间没洗澡了。

examples.en: I always take a bath before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我睡觉前总要洗个澡。

bathe.definition:
n. the act of swimming
v. cleanse the entire body
v. suffuse with or as if with light
v. clean one's body by immersion into water
bathe.translation: vt. 沐浴, 用水洗\nvi. 洗澡

examples.en: It is dangerous to bathe in this river.
examples.zh: 在这条河里游泳很危险。

examples.en: This river is dangerous to bathe in.
examples.zh: 在这河里游泳危险。

examples.en: I bathe once a day.
examples.zh: 我每天洗一次澡。

bathroom.definition: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet

examples.en: She came out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel.
examples.zh: 她围著一条浴巾从浴室走了出来。

examples.en: There's a red candle on top of the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 洗手台上有一个红色的蜡烛。

examples.en: Jonas left under the pretext of going to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 乔纳斯以去洗手间为借口离开了。

battery.definition:
n. group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
n. a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series
n. a collection of related things intended for use together
n. a unit composed of the pitcher and catcher
battery.translation: n. 电池, 殴打\n[化] 蓄电池

examples.en: The car won't start because the battery has run down.
examples.zh: 车发动不了因为电池没电了。

examples.en: This man is like a filthy electronic without a battery.
examples.zh: 这个男人简直像一台被扯掉了电源的肮脏电器。

examples.en: This battery is about to run out of juice.
examples.zh: 这电池快要没电了。

battle.definition: n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war\nv. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle

examples.en: This is the place where the battle took place.
examples.zh: 这是战斗发生的地方。

examples.en: The French were defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.
examples.zh: 法国人在滑铁卢之役吃了败仗。

examples.en: This is the place where the battle of Hastings took place.
examples.zh: 这里是黑斯廷斯战役发生的地方。

bay.definition:
n. an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf
n. the sound of a hound on the scent
n. a compartment on a ship between decks; often used as a hospital
n. a compartment in an aircraft used for some specific purpose
bay.translation: n. 海湾, 狗吠声, 月桂\nvt. 吠, 使走投无路\nvi. 吠

examples.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
examples.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。

examples.en: Mt. Fuji as seen from Suruga Bay is beautiful.
examples.zh: 从骏河湾看, 富士山很美丽。

examples.en: The airport is in Osaka Bay.
examples.zh: 机场在大阪湾。

beach.definition: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake\nv. land on a beach

examples.en: Today is a good day to run on the beach.
examples.zh: 今天是一个在海滩上跑步的好日子。

examples.en: He likes to go to the beach now and then.
examples.zh: 他喜欢偶尔去海边。

examples.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
examples.zh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。

beam.definition:
n. long thick piece of wood or metal or concrete, etc., used in construction
n. a group of nearly parallel lines of electromagnetic radiation
n. a column of light (as from a beacon)
n. (nautical) breadth amidships
beam.translation:
n. 横梁, 杆, 光线, 容光焕发
vi. 用梁支承, 微笑, 射出光线
vt. 照耀, 感到欣喜
[计] 束

examples.en: I'm checking for laser beam alarm triggers.
examples.zh: 我在检查这里有没有激光警报装置。

examples.en: Fortune beamed on him.
examples.zh: 好运向他露出了笑容。

bean.definition:
n. any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food
n. any of various seeds or fruits that are beans or resemble beans
n. any of various leguminous plants grown for their edible seeds and pods
v. hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball
bean.translation: n. 豆子\n[化] 油嘴; 豆

examples.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
examples.zh: 巴西向世界各地供应优质咖啡豆。

examples.en: Do you want to eat garbanzo beans?
examples.zh: 你想吃鹰嘴豆吗？

examples.en: What's your favorite way to cook beans?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢用什么方法煮豆子？

bear.definition:
n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws
n. an investor with a pessimistic market outlook; an investor who expects prices to fall and so sells now in order to buy later at a lower price
v. have
v. move while holding up or supporting
bear.translation: n. 熊\nvt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价\nvi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向

examples.en: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
examples.zh: 他们在雪地里找到了熊的脚印。

examples.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
examples.zh: 这冰太薄不能承受你的重量。

examples.en: Please bear with me until I finish the story.
examples.zh: 请容许我把故事讲完。

beard.definition:
n. the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face
n. a tuft or growth of hairs or bristles on certain plants such as iris or grasses
n. a person who diverts suspicion from someone (especially a woman who accompanies a male homosexual in order to conceal his homosexuality)
n. hairy growth on or near the face of certain mammals
beard.translation: n. 胡须\nvt. 抓住胡须, 公开反对

examples.en: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
examples.zh: 妈妈，为什么我没有长胡子的舅舅呢？

examples.en: This is the first time I've ever grown a beard.
examples.zh: 这是我第一次长胡子。

examples.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
examples.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

bearing.definition:
n. relevant relation or interconnection
n. the direction or path along which something moves or along which it lies
n. dignified manner or conduct
n. a rotating support placed between moving parts to allow them to move easily
bearing.translation: n. 举止, 轴承, 忍受, 关系, 意义, 方向, 生育\n[化] 轴承

examples.en: It has some bearing on this problem.
examples.zh: 它和这个问题有点关系。

beast.translation: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性

examples.en: You filthy beast, get out of here!
examples.zh: 你这个畜牲，给我滚开！

examples.en: The lion is the king of the beasts.
examples.zh: 狮子是百兽之王。

examples.en: What beast dost thou think thou art? Art thou a hound or a rat?
examples.zh: 你认为你是什么野兽？猎犬还是老鼠？

beat.definition:
n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman
n. a single pulsation of an oscillation produced by adding two waves of different frequencies; has a frequency equal to the difference between the two oscillations
n. the sound of stroke or blow
n. a regular rate of repetition
beat.translation:
n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子
v. 打, 拍打, 打败
a. 疲乏的, 颓废的
beat的过去式
[计] 拍; 节拍

examples.en: Red is very pretty, but it still can't beat blue.
examples.zh: 红色很漂亮，但还比不过蓝色。

examples.en: As far as English is concerned, nobody can beat me.
examples.zh: 在英语能力方面，没有人能比我好。

examples.en: The color red is beautiful, but it can't beat blue.
examples.zh: 红色很漂亮，但还比不过蓝色。

beautiful.definition: a. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration\ns. (of weather) highly enjoyable

examples.en: It is my pleasure to wait for a beautiful lady.
examples.zh: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。

examples.en: You are the most beautiful girl I have ever seen.
examples.zh: 你是我见过的最漂亮的女孩。

examples.en: The color red is beautiful, but it can't beat blue.
examples.zh: 红色很漂亮，但还比不过蓝色。

beauty.definition: n. the qualities that give pleasure to the senses\nn. an outstanding example of its kind

examples.en: She will be a beauty when she grows up.
examples.zh: 她长大后一定会是个美人。

examples.en: There is no doubt as to her beauty.
examples.zh: 她的美貌是毫无疑问的。

examples.en: A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
examples.zh: 凡美的事物就是永恒的喜悦。

because.definition: conj. By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the\n   reason that.\nconj. In order that; that.

examples.en: I didn't call on him because I had a cold.
examples.zh: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

examples.en: I didn't go to the party because I was sick.
examples.zh: 我病了，所以那次聚会没去。

examples.en: It's because I was asked to come that I'm here.
examples.zh: 有人叫我来，我才来的。

become.definition:
v. enter or assume a certain state or condition
v. undergo a change or development
v. come into existence
v. enhance the appearance of
become.translation: vi. 变成, 变得\nvt. 适合

examples.en: She is proud that her son has become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她为自己的儿子成为医生而自豪。

examples.en: Tom told me that he'd like to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 汤姆告诉我他想当医生。

examples.en: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
examples.zh: 一直染发太麻烦了。

bed.definition:
n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
n. a plot of ground in which plants are growing
n. a depression forming the ground under a body of water
n. (geology) a stratum of rock (especially sedimentary rock)
bed.translation: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层\nvt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装\nvi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层

examples.en: This is what you got me out of bed for?
examples.zh: 你把我从床上叫起来就是为了这个？

examples.en: I was tired today so I went to bed early.
examples.zh: 我今天累，所以我睡得早。

examples.en: I was very tired, so I went to bed early.
examples.zh: 我很累所以早睡了。

bedroom.definition: n. a room used primarily for sleeping

examples.en: Your bedroom doesn't have even a single person in it.
examples.zh: 你的卧室里一个人也没有。

examples.en: I said that this was a meeting room, not a bedroom!
examples.zh: 我说过了，这是一个会议室，不是卧室。

examples.en: I already said, this is a meeting room, not a bedroom.
examples.zh: 我说过了，这是一个会议室，不是卧室。

bee.definition: n. any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species\nn. a social gathering to carry out some communal task or to hold competitions

examples.en: Without bee pollination, California's almond crop, for example, would be non-existent.
examples.zh: 例如，如果没有蜜蜂授粉，加州的杏仁作物就不会存在。

examples.en: You are always as busy as a bee.
examples.zh: 你总是跟蜜蜂一样地忙碌。

examples.en: The buzzing of the bees makes me a little nervous.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂的嗡嗡让我紧张一点。

beef.definition: n. cattle that are reared for their meat\nn. meat from an adult domestic bovine
beef.translation: n. 牛肉, 肌肉\nvt. 养(牛), 宰(牛)\nvi. 抱怨, 告发

examples.en: I asked you to buy beef, not pork.
examples.zh: 我叫你买牛肉，没叫你买猪肉。

examples.en: Should we order the steamed perch or the beef with oyster sauce?
examples.zh: 叫个清蒸鲈鱼好呢，还是蚝油牛肉好？

examples.en: I don't eat pork, beef or eggs.
examples.zh: 猪肉，牛肉，鸡蛋我都不吃。

beer.definition: n. a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops

examples.en: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日来杯冰凉的啤酒，人生一乐也！

examples.en: I suspect they water down the beer in that pub.
examples.zh: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

examples.en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
examples.zh: 麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

before.definition: r earlier in time; previously\nr at or in the front
before.translation: prep. 在...之前\nconj. 在...之前\nadv. 在前

examples.en: My father is not as well as he was before.
examples.zh: 我父亲没之前好了。

examples.en: It was a week before Jane got over her cold.
examples.zh: Jane感冒了一周才好。

examples.en: It is difficult for me to get up before six.
examples.zh: 我早上六时之前总是起不了床。

beforehand.definition: s being ahead of time or need\nr ahead of time; in anticipation

examples.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
examples.zh: 万一来不了，我会先给你打电话。

examples.en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
examples.zh: 请你事先把计划告诉我。

examples.en: Let me know beforehand instead of springing it on me at the last minute.
examples.zh: 事先打个招呼，别叫我临时抓瞎。

beg.definition: v. call upon in supplication; entreat\nv. ask to obtain free\nv. dodge, avoid answering, or take for granted
beg.translation: v. 乞求, 乞讨, 请求

examples.en: I beg your pardon; I didn't quite catch your name.
examples.zh: 能再说一次吗？我没听清楚你的名字。

examples.en: Tom begged his father to buy him a new bicycle.
examples.zh: 汤姆求他父亲给他买新自行车。

examples.en: When only death remains, the last resort is to beg for food.
examples.zh: 除死无大事，讨饭到了家。

begin.definition:
n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992)
v. have a beginning, in a temporal, spatial, or evaluative sense
v. set in motion, cause to start
v. begin to speak or say

examples.en: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.
examples.zh: 感到惊讶、感到惊奇就是明白的开始。

examples.en: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
examples.zh: 如果我们早点开始的话，就能在午饭时间之前完成。

examples.en: Since you are here, we might as well begin.
examples.zh: 既然你在这里, 那我们就开始吧。

beginning.definition:
n. the event consisting of the start of something
n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
n. the first part or section of something
n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being

examples.en: Calm down, and listen to me speak from the beginning.
examples.zh: 你们冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。

examples.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
examples.zh: 起初，神创造了天地。

examples.en: I hope this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
examples.zh: 希望这是美好友谊的开始。

behalf.definition: n. as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as "on behalf of" rather than "in behalf of"); \nn. for someone's benefit (usually expressed as `in behalf' rather than `on behalf' and usually with a possessive)

examples.en: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
examples.zh: 请代我向你的家人问好。

examples.en: I thank you on behalf of my son.
examples.zh: 我为我的儿子向您致谢。

examples.en: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
examples.zh: 我代表公司欢迎你的来临。

behave.definition: v. behave in a certain manner\nv. behave well or properly
behave.translation: vi. 举止端正, 行为规矩\nvt. 检点(自己的)行为, 使表现好

examples.en: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
examples.zh: 他为自己的行为感到非常羞耻。

examples.en: Many people cannot understand the way hackers behave.
examples.zh: 很多人无法理解黑客们的行为。

examples.en: Tom knows how to behave in public.
examples.zh: 汤姆知道在公众场合怎么样自处。

behavior.definition: n. manner of acting or controlling yourself\nn. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances\nn. (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation
behavior.translation: n. 行为, 举止\n[医] 行为

examples.en: This behavior shows a lack of respect for the performance.
examples.zh: 这种行为是对演出的不尊重。

examples.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
examples.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

examples.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
examples.zh: 他的日常行为并不和他的原则相一致。

behind.definition:
s. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest
r. in or to or toward the rear
r. remaining in a place or condition that has been left or departed from
r. of timepieces
behind.translation: adv. 在后地\nprep. 在...背后

examples.en: Do you know for sure that Tom is behind that?
examples.zh: 你确信汤姆躲在那后面吗？

examples.en: We must not speak ill of others behind their backs.
examples.zh: 我们不应该在背后说别人的坏话。

examples.en: I don't like people talking about me behind my back.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢别人在背后议论我。

being.definition: n. the state or fact of existing
being.translation: n. 存在, 性质, 生命, 人, 生物, be的现在分词

examples.en: I feel like I am being forced to help her.
examples.zh: 我感觉我被强制帮助她。

examples.en: So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
examples.zh: 我们乘车去以免迟到

examples.en: Such being the case, I can not go with you.
examples.zh: 这样的话我不能和你一起去。

belief.definition: n. any cognitive content held as true
belief.translation: n. 信念, 相信, 信仰

examples.en: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
examples.zh: 我坚信他是无辜的。

examples.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.
examples.zh: 我相信，知识就是力量。

examples.en: His behavior is contrary to his belief.
examples.zh: 他的行为和他的信念背道而驰。

believe.definition:
v. accept as true; take to be true
v. be confident about something
v. follow a credo; have a faith; be a believer
v. credit with veracity

examples.en: We have full reason to believe that it is true.
examples.zh: 我们有充分的理由相信这是真的。

examples.en: I can't believe that Tom did all this by himself.
examples.zh: 我真不敢相信这些全都是汤姆自己一个人做的。

examples.en: Tom doesn't believe a word of what Mary just said.
examples.zh: 玛莉刚才说的话汤姆一句也不信。

bell.definition:
n. a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck
n. the sound of a bell being struck
n. (nautical) each of the eight half-hour units of nautical time signaled by strokes of a ship's bell; eight bells signals 4:00, 8:00, or 12:00 o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.
n. the shape of a bell
bell.translation: n. 铃, 钟\n[计] 响铃命令

examples.en: I don't want red bell peppers, I want green ones.
examples.zh: 我不要红色的柿子椒, 而是要绿色的。

examples.en: He came in, and at the same time the bell rang.
examples.zh: 他进来的同时，铃响了。

examples.en: The bell rang and the train moved off.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，火车就开动了。

belly.definition:
n. a protruding abdomen
n. a part that bulges deeply
n. the hollow inside of something
n. the underpart of the body of certain vertebrates such as snakes or fish
belly.translation: n. 腹部, 食欲\nvt. 使鼓起\nvi. 鼓起, 匍匐前进

examples.en: He had an infection in his belly button.
examples.zh: 他的肚脐发炎了。

examples.en: Koala bears do not have belly buttons.
examples.zh: 无尾熊没有肚脐。

examples.en: I hit him in the belly.
examples.zh: 我打了他的肚子。

belong.definition:
v. be owned by; be in the possession of
v. be suitable or acceptable
v. be in the right place or situation
v. be rightly classified in a class or category

examples.en: Who does the car belong to when the owner dies?
examples.zh: 主人死后车子归谁呢？

examples.en: No one may be compelled to belong to an association.
examples.zh: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。

examples.en: Which Buddhist school of thought do they belong to?
examples.zh: 他们属于哪一个佛教宗派？

below.definition: r. in or to a place that is lower\nr. at a later place\nr. (in writing) see below
below.translation: prep. 在下面\nadv. 在下面

examples.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
examples.zh: 关于下面的内容，我想确认两件事情。

examples.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
examples.zh: 零度以下的气温持续了好几天。

examples.en: Use a dictionary to find the meanings of the phrases below.
examples.zh: 用字典查出下面词组的意思。

belt.definition:
n. endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys
n. a band to tie or buckle around the body (usually at the waist)
n. an elongated region where a specific condition or characteristic is found
n. ammunition (usually of small caliber) loaded in flexible linked strips for use in a machine gun
belt.translation: n. 带子, 地带\n[医] 带, 腰带, 束带, 地带, 区

examples.en: China is incorporating Algeria into its Belt and Road strategy.
examples.zh: 中国正将阿尔及利亚纳入「一带一路」战略。

examples.en: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
examples.zh: 这条腰带对我来说成为了恐惧的象征。

examples.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
examples.zh: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。

bench.definition:
n. a long seat for more than one person
n. the magistrate or judge or judges sitting in court in judicial capacity to compose the court collectively
n. the reserve players on a team
n. (law) the seat for judges in a courtroom

examples.en: I often slept on that bench when I was homeless.
examples.zh: 当我无家可归的时候，我常在那张长椅上睡觉。

examples.en: Tom sat on that park bench for nearly three hours.
examples.zh: 汤姆在公园的长椅上坐了将近三个小时。

examples.en: They sat on a park bench and began talking.
examples.zh: 他们坐在公园的长椅上，谈起了话来。

bend.definition:
n. a circular segment of a curve
n. curved segment (of a road or river or railroad track etc.)
n. a town in central Oregon at the eastern foot of the Cascade Range
n. diagonal line traversing a shield from the upper right corner to the lower left
bend.translation: vi. 变弯曲, 屈服\nvt. 使弯曲, 使屈服\nn. 弯曲

examples.en: Tom took the bend too fast and landed in the ditch.
examples.zh: 汤姆拐弯儿拐得太快了，把车开到了水沟里。

examples.en: Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦预测太阳的引力会弯曲光线。

examples.en: He has back pain, he can't bend over.
examples.zh: 他背疼，不能弯腰。

beneath.definition: r in or to a place that is lower
beneath.translation: prep. 在...下方\nadv. 在...下方

examples.en: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
examples.zh: 那些钱藏了在地板下面。

examples.en: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
examples.zh: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。

examples.en: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.
examples.zh: 她与强大的祖琳女王有著密切的血缘关系，她的家在一棵枝繁叶茂的橡树荫下。

beneficial.translation: a. 有益的, 受益的\n[经] 有使用权的, 可享利益的

examples.en: Others say it may even be beneficial.
examples.zh: 其他人说它甚至可能是有益的。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
examples.zh: 多运动有益健康。

examples.en: Not all animals are beneficial.
examples.zh: 不是所有的动物都是有益的。

benefit.definition:
n. financial assistance in time of need
n. something that aids or promotes well-being
n. a performance to raise money for a charitable cause
v. be beneficial for
benefit.translation: n. 利益\nvt. 有益于\nvi. 受益

examples.en: Does doing things in this way have a benefit?
examples.zh: 这么做有什么好处吗？

examples.en: Doing things in this way has no benefit.
examples.zh: 这么做没什么好处。

examples.en: A portion of the proceeds will go to benefit children with disabilities.
examples.zh: 我们会把一部分筹得的款项用来帮助残疾儿童。

berry.definition:
n. any of numerous small and pulpy edible fruits; used as desserts or in making jams and jellies and preserves
n. a small fruit having any of various structures, e.g., simple (grape or blueberry) or aggregate (blackberry or raspberry)
n. United States rock singer (born in 1931)
v. pick or gather berries
berry.translation: n. 浆果\nvi. 采集浆果

examples.en: "Vaya" means "wow," "baya" means "berry," and "valla" means "fence."
examples.zh: "Vaya"的意思是"哇哦"，"baya"的意思是"浆果"，"valla"的意思是"栅栏"。

examples.en: Acai is a berry that comes from the state of Pará, Brazil.
examples.zh: 阿萨伊是一种产自巴西帕拉州的浆果。

examples.en: Twenty-five years after Chernobyl, milk, mushrooms and berries are still contaminated in some parts of Ukraine.
examples.zh: 在切尔诺贝利核电厂事故二十五年后，在乌克兰的某些地区，牛奶，蘑菇和浆果仍然受到了污染。

beside.definition:
n. At the side of; on one side of.
n. Aside from; out of the regular course or order of; in a
   state of deviation from; out of.
n. Over and above; distinct from; in addition to.
adv. On one side.
adv. More than that; over and above; not included in the
   number, or in what has been mentioned; moreover; in addition.

examples.en: What he said was beside the point.
examples.zh: 他说的话跑题了。

examples.en: She was beside herself with joy.
examples.zh: 她欣喜若狂。

examples.en: Everybody wants to sit beside her.
examples.zh: 大家都想坐在她旁边。

besides.definition: r. making an additional point; anyway; besides, we can't afford it"\nr. in addition
besides.translation: prep. 除...之外\nadv. 而且, 此外

examples.en: There was no one in the room besides Tom and Mary.
examples.zh: 除了汤姆和玛丽，房间里没有人。

examples.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
examples.zh: 她不但是一个演员，她还曾是一个著名的画家。

examples.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
examples.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

best.definition: n. the supreme effort one can make\nn. the person who is most outstanding or excellent; someone who tops all others\nn. Canadian physiologist (born in the United States) who assisted F. G. Banting in research leading to the discovery of insulin (1899-1978)
best.translation: a. 最好的\nadv. 最好地\nn. 最好的人

examples.en: That is one of my best time in my life.
examples.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。

examples.en: She will do her best to be here on time.
examples.zh: 她会尽量按时赶来的。

examples.en: I will help him to the best of my ability.
examples.zh: 我将会尽我所能地帮助他。

bestow.translation: vt. 授予, 使用, 贮藏, 留宿

examples.en: That's a real strongman, bestow upon him a goblet of wine!
He bestowed a large amount of money on the institute.
The sun is bestowing light and warmth on me.

bet.definition: n. the act of gambling\nv. maintain with or as if with a bet\nv. stake on the outcome of an issue
bet.translation: n. 打赌, 赌注\nv. 打赌

examples.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.
examples.zh: 我赌她赢这比赛。

examples.en: I'll bet you a hundred dollars that Tom is gay.
examples.zh: 我和你赌一百元，汤姆是同性恋。

examples.en: I bet Tom and Mary have never even been to Boston.
examples.zh: 我很肯定汤姆和玛丽从来没去过波士顿。

betray.definition: v. reveal unintentionally\nv. deliver to an enemy by treachery
betray.translation: vt. 出卖, 背叛, 辜负, 暴露\n[法] 出卖, 背叛, 泄漏

examples.en: John isn't the kind of man who would betray you.
examples.zh: 约翰不是那种会背叛你的人。

examples.en: Doing this is to betray the trust of your friends.
examples.zh: 你这样做，辜负了朋友对你的信任。

examples.en: He would rather lose his life than betray his organization.
examples.zh: 他宁可牺牲生命，也不出卖组织。

better.definition:
n. something superior in quality or condition or effect
n. a superior person having claim to precedence
n. the superior one of two alternatives
v. surpass in excellence
better.translation: a. 较好的\nadv. 比较好

examples.en: He is able to do it better than I am.
examples.zh: 他有能力比我做得更好。

examples.en: It is better to do well than to say well.
examples.zh: 说的好不如做的好

examples.en: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
examples.zh: 想酒量大一些。

between.definition: r. in the interval\nr. in between

examples.en: Between you and me, I think our boss is stupid.
examples.zh: 我觉得我们老板很蠢，这我就只跟你说。

examples.en: Between you and me, what is your opinion of her?
examples.zh: 你就只告诉我一个人，你对她的意见如何？

examples.en: Between you and me, he's in trouble with the boss.
examples.zh: 他和老板有矛盾，这个我们知道就好。

beverage.definition: n. any liquid suitable for drinking
beverage.translation: n. 饮料\n[化] 饮料(如牛奶、茶、咖啡、啤酒等)

examples.en: People who drink alcoholic beverages are not allowed to enter.
examples.zh: 饮酒者不准禁入。

examples.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢喝太甜的饮料。

examples.en: What beverages do you like to drink?
examples.zh: 你喜欢喝什么饮料？

bewilder.definition: v. cause to be confused emotionally
bewilder.translation: vt. 使迷惑, 使不知所措

examples.en: I was bewildered at the sight of his strange behavior.
I was completely bewildered by his sudden change of mood.
I was bewildered by his behavior in the restaurant.

beyond.definition: r. farther along in space or time or degree\nr. on the farther side from the observer\nr. in addition
beyond.translation: prep. 超过, 在那一边, 迟于\nadv. 在远处\nn. 更远处

examples.en: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
examples.zh: 盖我自己的房子超出了我的能力范围。

examples.en: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
examples.zh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

examples.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
examples.zh: 你看过富士山吗? 它美得无法形容。

bias.definition:
n. a partiality that prevents objective consideration of an issue or situation
v. influence in an unfair way
v. cause to be biased
s. slanting diagonally across the grain of a fabric
bias.translation:
n. 偏见, 斜纹
a. 偏斜的
adv. 偏斜
vt. 使有偏见
[计] 偏流; 偏压; 偏磁; 偏离

examples.en: People tend to look at others with bias.
examples.zh: 人们趋向于带着偏见看待他人。

bible.definition: n. the sacred writings of the Christian religions\nn. a book regarded as authoritative in its field

examples.en: Every time I read the Bible, I am deeply moved.
examples.zh: 每次我读圣经都会被深深地感动。

examples.en: According to the Bible, God made the world in six days.
examples.zh: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

examples.en: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
examples.zh: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

bicycle.definition: n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals\nv. ride a bicycle

examples.en: Does he go to school on foot or by bicycle?
examples.zh: 他走路去学校还是骑车去学校？

examples.en: I didn't have a bicycle when I was growing up.
examples.zh: 小时候我没有自行车。

examples.en: Some go to school by bicycle, others go by bus.
examples.zh: 有的(人)骑单车上学，其他(人)乘巴士。

bid.definition:
n. an attempt to get something
n. a formal proposal to buy at a specified price
n. (bridge) the number of tricks a bridge player is willing to contract to make
v. ask for or request earnestly
bid.translation: n. 出价\nv. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标

examples.en: I bid you greetings and may there be peace through fellowship between us.
examples.zh: 我向你们致以问候，愿我们之间的友谊带来和平。

examples.en: How much did you bid?
examples.zh: 你出价多少？

examples.en: He bade farewell to the students.
examples.zh: 他向学生们告别了。

big.definition:
s. significant
s. loud and firm
s. conspicuous in position or importance
s. prodigious
big.translation: a. 大的, 重要的\nadv. 大量地

examples.en: My room is small, but it's big enough for me.
examples.zh: 我的房间很小，但对我来说已经够大了。

examples.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
examples.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

examples.en: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
examples.zh: 住在大城市的人们一般都缺乏锻炼。

bill.definition:
n. a statute in draft before it becomes law
n. an itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
n. a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank)
n. the entertainment offered at a public presentation
bill.translation: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据\nvt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布

examples.en: Last month I spent a fortune on the telephone bill.
examples.zh: 上个月我在话费上花了很多钱。

examples.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
examples.zh: 该法案的说客把游说贿款汇入了竞选基金。

examples.en: Well, Bill, I am pleased to see you here.
examples.zh: 呃，比尔，我很高兴在这里见到你。

billion.definition:
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros; in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 9 zeros
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one million million items or units in Great Britain

examples.en: The age of the universe is about 13.75 billion years.
examples.zh: 宇宙的年龄大约为137.5亿年。

examples.en: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
examples.zh: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。

examples.en: More than a billion people live in China.
examples.zh: 中国有超过十亿人口。

bind.definition:
n. something that hinders as if with bonds
v. create social or emotional ties
v. make fast; tie or secure, with or as if with a rope
v. wrap around with something so as to cover or enclose
bind.translation: vt. 绑, 约束, 装订, 包扎, 使结合\nvi. 凝固, 有约束力\n[计] 赋值, 绑定

examples.en: I'm forever lost, can't you see? I'm in a bind!
I am in a bind as my money has been stolen.
Break free from the chains that bind you!

biography.definition: n. an account of the series of events making up a person's life

examples.en: Lincoln's biography is read by children all around the world.
He was writing a biography of a famous poet.
Tom's biography is that of an honest Soviet worker.

biology.definition: n. the science that studies living organisms\nn. characteristic life processes and phenomena of living organisms
biology.translation: n. 生物学\n[化] 生物; 生物学

examples.en: She studied the bat's anatomy for her biology project.
examples.zh: 她为了完成生物学作业，研究了蝙蝠的解剖构造。

examples.en: He is very much interested in biology.
examples.zh: 他对生物学很感兴趣。

examples.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
examples.zh: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。

bird.definition: n. warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings\nn. the flesh of a bird or fowl (wild or domestic) used as food\nv. watch and study birds in their natural habitat
bird.translation: n. 鸟, 羽毛球\nvi. 打鸟

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
examples.zh: 如果我是一只小鸟，我就可以飞到你的身边了。

examples.en: The blue bird is perched on a branch, singing cheerfully.
examples.zh: 蓝色的鸟栖息在树枝上，兴致昂扬地唱着歌。

examples.en: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
examples.zh: 那只鸟的体积有半只老鹰那么大。

birth.definition: n. the time when something begins (especially life)\nn. the event of being born\nn. a baby born; an offspring
birth.translation: n. 出生, 起源\n[医] 生产, 分娩

examples.en: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
examples.zh: 他们第一个孩子出生了，很高兴。

examples.en: She will give birth to a child next month.
examples.zh: 她下个月生孩子。

examples.en: She gave birth on Monday to her first child.
examples.zh: 她于周一生下了她的第一个孩子。

birthday.definition: n. an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)\nn. the date on which a person was born

examples.en: I will give you a new bicycle for your birthday.
examples.zh: 生日的时候我会送你一辆新脚踏车。

examples.en: There will be a lot of birthday cards sent soon.
examples.zh: 很快会有很多生日贺卡送到。

examples.en: We all chipped in to buy Tom a birthday present.
examples.zh: 我们大家凑钱给汤姆买了一份生日礼物。

biscuit.definition: n. small round bread leavened with baking-powder or soda
biscuit.translation: n. 饼干\n[化] 素坯; 饼干

examples.en: He shared his box of biscuits with all his friends.
examples.zh: 他和他所有的朋友分享了他的那盒饼干。

examples.en: "Mum, can I have a biscuit?" "No, you shouldn't eat between meals."
examples.zh: "妈妈，我能吃一块饼干吗？" "不行，不该在3餐间吃。"

examples.en: I think we need more biscuits.
examples.zh: 我觉得我们需要更多饼干。

bit.definition:
n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
n. piece of metal held in horse's mouth by reins and used to control the horse while riding
n. a unit of measurement of information (from binary + digit); the amount of information in a system having two equiprobable states
n. the part of a key that enters a lock and lifts the tumblers
bit.translation:
n. 少量, 马嚼子, 辅币
vt. 给马上嚼子, 控制
bite的过去式和过去分词
[计] 比特, 二进制数位, 机内测试

examples.en: It's a bit slow, can you wait for a bit?
examples.zh: 现在有点慢，能不能等一下？

examples.en: If you do it a bit slower, it goes quicker.
examples.zh: 如果你做慢一点, 它就会进行的快一点。

examples.en: But, I don't eat even a little bit of meat.
examples.zh: 但是，我一点儿肉也不吃。

bite.definition:
n. a wound resulting from biting by an animal or a person
n. a light informal meal
n. (angling) an instance of a fish taking the bait
n. the act of gripping or chewing off with the teeth and jaws
bite.translation: n. 咬, 一口\nv. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透

examples.en: If you bite me, then I'll bite you, too.
examples.zh: 你如果咬我，我也要咬你。

examples.en: We suspect it's about a poisoning by snake bite.
examples.zh: 我们猜这是一种被蛇咬伤的毒。

examples.en: If you bite me, I'll bite you back.
examples.zh: 如果你咬我，我就咬回来。

bitter.definition:
n. English term for a dry sharp-tasting ale with strong flavor of hops (usually on draft)
n. the taste experience when quinine or coffee is taken into the mouth
v. make bitter
s. very difficult to accept or bear
bitter.translation: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的\nadv. 刺骨\nv. (使)变苦

examples.en: His bitter words still rankle in my mind.
examples.zh: 他尖刻的话语仍然在我心中挥之不去。

examples.en: Good medicine is bitter to the mouth.
examples.zh: 良药苦口。

examples.en: This beer is bitter.
examples.zh: 这种啤酒有苦味。

black.definition:
n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white)
n. British chemist who identified carbon dioxide and who formulated the concepts of specific heat and latent heat (1728-1799)
n. popular child actress of the 1930's (born in 1928)
n. a person with dark skin who comes from Africa (or whose ancestors came from Africa)
black.translation: n. 黑色, 黑颜料\na. 黑色的

examples.en: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
examples.zh: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。

examples.en: I have a black dog and a white dog.
examples.zh: 我有一只黑狗和一只白狗。

examples.en: We have three dogs, one white and two black.
examples.zh: 我们有三只狗,一白两黑.

blade.definition:
n. especially a leaf of grass or the broad portion of a leaf as distinct from the petiole
n. a dashing young man
n. something long and thin resembling a blade of grass
n. a cut of beef from the shoulder blade
blade.translation: n. 叶片, 刀锋, 刀口, 剑\n[医] 页[片], 叶片, 刀片, 刀刃, 刀口

examples.en: The knife has a keen blade.
examples.zh: 这把刀的刀锋很利。

blame.definition:
n. a reproach for some lapse or misdeed
v. put or pin the blame on
v. harass with constant criticism
v. attribute responsibility to
blame.translation: n. 过失, 责备\nvt. 责备, 归咎于

examples.en: It is you that are to blame for it.
examples.zh: 责任应该由你来负。

examples.en: Don’t you try and blame this on him.
examples.zh: 你少把一切都推到他头上。

examples.en: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
examples.zh: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。

blank.definition:
n. a piece of material ready to be made into something
n. a cartridge containing an explosive charge but no bullet
v. keep the opposing (baseball) team from winning
s. (of a surface) not written or printed on
blank.translation:
n. 空格, 空白
a. 空白的, 空虚的, 完全的, 无色的
vi. 消失, 成为空白
vt. 使无效, 取消, 封锁
[计] 空白

examples.en: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
examples.zh: 请在空格上填上适当的字词。

examples.en: My mind was blank.
examples.zh: 我的脑一片空白。

examples.en: I'm in the habit of taking handwritten notes, yet I still often draw a blank when picking up a pen.
examples.zh: 我有手写笔记的习惯，但依然经常提笔忘字。

blanket.definition:
n. bedding that keeps a person warm in bed
n. anything that covers
n. a layer of lead surrounding the highly reactive core of a nuclear reactor
v. cover as if with a blanket
blanket.translation: n. 毛毯, 毯子\nvt. 掩盖, 覆盖\na. 总共的

examples.en: Mom took the blanket along with the bedsheet to wash.
examples.zh: 妈妈把被单连同床单一起拿去洗了。

examples.en: Can you give me a pillow and a blanket?
examples.zh: 给我一个枕头和毛毯好吗？

examples.en: The dog fell asleep on top of the blanket.
examples.zh: 狗在毯子上睡著了。

blast.definition:
n. a very long fly ball
n. an explosion (as of dynamite)
v. make a strident sound
v. use explosives on
blast.translation: n. 一阵风, 爆炸, 枯萎病\nvt. 炸, 使枯萎\nvi. 炸, 猛攻, 猛烈抨击, 枯萎

examples.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
examples.zh: 冰冷的疾风吹到我骨子里去了。

examples.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
examples.zh: 收音机广播充斥著有关最近爆炸的新闻。

examples.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
examples.zh: 冷空气疾风席卷整栋房子。

blaze.definition:
n. a strong flame that burns brightly
n. a light-colored marking
v. shine brightly and intensively
v. burn brightly and intensely
blaze.translation: n. 火焰, 烈火, 光辉\nvi. 燃烧, 发光\nvt. 使燃烧, 宣布, 在树皮上刻痕

examples.en: The firemen quickly extinguished the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防队很快就把大火扑熄。

bleed.definition: v. draw blood\nv. get or extort (money or other possessions) from someone\nv. drain of liquid or steam
bleed.translation: vi. 流血, 悲痛, 渗出\nvt. 使出血, 榨取

examples.en: If you prick us, do we not bleed?
examples.zh: 你们要是用刀剑刺向我们，我们难道不会流血吗？

examples.en: His wounded leg began to bleed again.
examples.zh: 他受伤的脚又开始流血了。

examples.en: I bleed when I make love.
examples.zh: 我性交的时候会出血。

blend.definition:
n. an occurrence of thorough mixing
n. a new word formed by joining two others and combining their meanings
n. the act of blending components together thoroughly
v. combine into one

examples.en: Oil and water won't blend with each other.
examples.zh: 油和水不能混合。

examples.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
examples.zh: 将混合物搅拌均匀。

examples.en: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.
examples.zh: 会场内，掌声、哨声、喊声、笑声乱成了一锅粥。

bless.definition: v. give a benediction to\nv. confer prosperity or happiness on\nv. make the sign of the cross over someone in order to call on God for protection; consecrate
bless.translation: vt. 祝福, 祈佑, 使神圣化

examples.en: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
examples.zh: 施比受更有福。

examples.en: Thank you. God bless you. And may God bless the United States of America.
examples.zh: 感谢你们。上帝保佑你们。愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国

examples.en: I am blessed with good health.
examples.zh: 上帝赐予我健康的身体。

blessing.definition: n. the formal act of approving\nn. a desirable state\nn. the act of praying for divine protection

examples.en: Those who count their blessings experience more joy.
examples.zh: 知足者常乐。

examples.en: We consider it a blessing.
examples.zh: 我们把它当作福分。

blind.definition:
n. people who have severe visual impairments, considered as a group
n. a hiding place sometimes used by hunters (especially duck hunters)
n. a protective covering that keeps things out or hinders sight
v. render unable to see
blind.translation:
n. 蒙蔽物, 窗帘
a. 盲目的, 瞎的, 不加思考的
vt. 使失明, 蒙蔽, 遮暗
adv. 盲目地

examples.en: Love is blind, but jealousy can see even nonexistent things.
examples.zh: 爱是盲目的，但是嫉妒却可以看到即使并不存在的东西。

examples.en: What greater misfortune is there than to go blind?
examples.zh: 有什么比失明更不幸的呢？

examples.en: My mother told me that if I masturbated, I'd go blind.
examples.zh: 我妈告诉我要是自慰我就会瞎。

blink.definition: n. a reflex that closes and opens the eyes rapidly\nv. briefly shut the eyes
blink.translation:
vi. 眨眼, 闪亮
vt. 眨眼, 使闪亮
n. 眨眼, 瞬间, 闪光, 闪烁
[计] 闪烁

examples.en: How many times a minute does the average person blink?
examples.zh: 人平均一分钟眨几次眼睛？

examples.en: He left in the blink of an eye.
examples.zh: 他一转眼就跑了。

examples.en: It happened in the blink of an eye.
examples.zh: 它发生在一眨眼之间。

bliss.definition: n. a state of extreme happiness
bliss.translation: n. 福佑, 天赐的福\n[计] 实现系统软件的基本语言

examples.en: Ignorance is bliss.
examples.zh: 无知就是幸福。

block.definition:
n. a solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides)
n. a rectangular area in a city surrounded by streets and usually containing several buildings
n. a three-dimensional shape with six square or rectangular sides
n. a number or quantity of related things dealt with as a unit
block.translation: n. 街区, 木块, 石块, 块\nvt. 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状\n[计] 块, 数据块

examples.en: She lives a block away and her name is Susan.
examples.zh: 她住在一个街区之外，名叫苏珊。

examples.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。

examples.en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.
examples.zh: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。

blog.definition: v. read, write, or edit a shared on-line journal
blog.translation: n. 博客；部落格；网络日志

examples.en: I've just published a new post on my blog.
examples.zh: 我刚在我的博客上发表了一个新帖子。

examples.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
examples.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

examples.en: Have you ever written a blog?
examples.zh: 你写过博客吗？

blood.definition:
n. the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets
n. temperament or disposition
n. people viewed as members of a group
v. smear with blood, as in a hunting initiation rite, where the face of a person is smeared with the blood of the kill
blood.translation: n. 血, 血统, 流血, 气质, 生命\nvt. 使出血, 用血涂

examples.en: It wasn't water flowing through the pipes, but human blood.
examples.zh: 管道里流的不是水，是人血。

examples.en: I've never seen so much blood in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生中从没见过那么多血。

examples.en: Very few people know what their blood group is.
examples.zh: 知道自己血型的人没几个。

bloom.definition: n. the best time of youth\nn. a rosy color (especially in the cheeks) taken as a sign of good health\nv. produce or yield flowers
bloom.translation: n. 花, 开花, 青春, 钢块\nvi. 开花, 焕发青春, 茂盛\nvt. 使茂盛, 把...轧成钢坯

examples.en: North China is cold in spring, so flowers don't bloom outdoors.
examples.zh: 春季的时候，中国北边很冷，所以在外边的花不开花。

examples.en: Cherry trees are now in bloom in Washington.
examples.zh: 华盛顿的樱花现在开放。

examples.en: These flowers bloom earlier than the others do.
examples.zh: 这些花比别的花早开花。

blouse.definition: n. a top worn by women

examples.en: She gave the blouse a quick wash.
examples.zh: 她很快地把衬衫洗一洗。

examples.en: Mary bought a shirt and a blouse.
examples.zh: 玛丽买了一件衬衫和一件女式衬衫。

examples.en: Janet bought a skirt and a blouse.
examples.zh: 珍妮特买了一条裙子和一件衬衫。

blow.definition:
n. a powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon
n. an impact (as from a collision)
n. forceful exhalation through the nose or mouth
v. exhale hard
blow.translation: n. 吹, 打击, 殴打, 花开\nv. 吹, 风吹, 吹响, 开花

examples.en: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.
examples.zh: 他们趁炸弹还没有爆炸的时候就把它拆掉了。

examples.en: The tree was felled with one hard blow of his ax.
examples.zh: 他用斧头重重的斩了一下，那棵树就倒了下来。

examples.en: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
examples.zh: 一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。

blue.definition:
n. blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime
n. blue clothing
n. any organization or party whose uniforms or badges are blue
n. any of numerous small butterflies of the family Lycaenidae
blue.translation:
n. 蓝色
a. 蓝色的, 下流的, 忧郁的
vt. 染成蓝色
vi. 变蓝

examples.en: Do you prefer the blue one or the red one?
examples.zh: 你喜欢蓝色的还是红色的？

examples.en: Do you know the reason why the sky looks blue?
examples.zh: 你知道为什么天看起来这么蓝吗？

examples.en: Tom is wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
examples.zh: 汤姆穿著一件黄色衬衫，系著一条蓝色领带。

blueprint.definition: n. something intended as a guide for making something else\nn. photographic print of plans or technical drawings etc.\nv. make a blueprint of
blueprint.translation: n. 蓝图, 设计图, (周详的)计划\nvt. 制成蓝图, 计划

examples.en: The natural world is always much more complex than formulations in the lab or blueprints in the design office.
examples.zh: 自然界从来都比试验室的配方或设计院的图纸里所反映的要复杂得多。

blur.definition:
n. a hazy or indistinct representation
v. to make less distinct or clear
v. make dim or indistinct
v. become vague or indistinct
blur.translation: vt. 使模糊, 弄脏\nvi. 弄脏, 模糊

examples.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
examples.zh: 可能会引起视力模糊、呼吸急促等副作用。

board.definition:
n. a committee having supervisory powers
n. a stout length of sawn timber; made in a wide variety of sizes and used for many purposes
n. a flat piece of material designed for a special purpose
n. food or meals in general
board.translation:
n. 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌
vt. 乘船, 供膳食, 用板覆盖
vi. 搭伙
[计] 板

examples.en: I moved a chess piece on the board one forward.
examples.zh: 我在棋盘上把一个棋子向前移动一步。

examples.en: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.
examples.zh: 她上飞机前，给我招了招手。

examples.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
examples.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

boast.definition: n. speaking of yourself in superlatives\nv. show off
boast.translation: n. 吹牛\nvi. 吹牛, 自夸\nvt. 夸口说, 自恃有

examples.en: He boasted of having won the first prize.
examples.zh: 他赢了冠军就自吹自擂了起来。

examples.en: He boasts that he can speak six languages.
examples.zh: 他显摆自己能说6种语言。

examples.en: She always boasts of being a good swimmer.
examples.zh: 她老是吹嘘自己是个游泳健将。

boat.definition: n. a small vessel for travel on water\nv. ride in a boat on water
boat.translation: n. 船\nvi. 乘船\nvt. 以船运

examples.en: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.
examples.zh: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。

examples.en: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
examples.zh: 现在下船，游到岸边。

examples.en: I am taking Tom on a boat trip tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要跟汤姆去坐船旅行

body.definition:
n. the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being)
n. a group of persons associated by some common tie or occupation and regarded as an entity
n. a natural object consisting of a dead animal or person
n. an individual 3-dimensional object that has mass and that is distinguishable from other objects
body.translation: n. 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体\nvt. 赋以形体\n[计] 体

examples.en: Me without you is like a body with no soul.
examples.zh: 没有了你，我就像没有灵魂的躯体。

examples.en: I know staying up overnight is bad for the body.
examples.zh: 我知道熬夜对身体不好。

examples.en: I'd like to know how the body absorbs these substances.
examples.zh: 我想知道这些物质是怎么被人体吸收的。

boil.definition:
n. a painful sore with a hard core filled with pus
v. come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor
v. immerse or be immersed in a boiling liquid, often for cooking purposes
v. bring to, or maintain at, the boiling point
boil.translation: n. 煮沸, 沸腾, 疖\nv. 煮沸, 激动

examples.en: It made my blood boil to hear that.
examples.zh: 听到这个让我感觉热血沸腾。

examples.en: When the pressure is lower, the boiling point is lower.
examples.zh: 压力越低，沸点越低。

examples.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 栗子至少要煮15分钟。

bold.definition: a. fearless and daring\ns. clear and distinct
bold.translation: a. 大胆的\nn. 粗体\n[计] 粗体

examples.en: It is bold of you to say such a thing.
May I be so bold as to request your assistance?
May I make so bold as to request your assistance?

bolt.definition:
n. a sliding bar in a breech-loading firearm that ejects an empty cartridge and replaces it and closes the breech
n. the part of a lock that is engaged or withdrawn with a key
n. a roll of cloth or wallpaper of a definite length
n. a screw that screws into a nut to form a fastener
bolt.translation:
n. 门闩, 螺钉, 筛子, 闪电, 意外事件
vt. 闩住, 发射, 脱口而出, 筛, 囫囵吞下
vi. 囫囵吞枣, 射箭, 脱缰, 退出党派
adv. 突然

examples.en: It was like a bolt out of the blue.
examples.zh: 晴天霹雳。

examples.en: A fool's bolt is soon shot.
examples.zh: 蠢人一下子就把箭射完。

examples.en: I've got the bolts. Where are the nuts?
examples.zh: 螺栓我找到了，螺帽在哪里？

bomb.definition: n. an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions
bomb.translation: n. 炸弹\nvt. 轰炸, 投弹于\nvi. 失败

examples.en: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
examples.zh: 原子弹是二十世纪物理学的产物。

examples.en: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.
examples.zh: 他们趁炸弹还没有爆炸的时候就把它拆掉了。

examples.en: When the bomb exploded, I happened to be there.
examples.zh: 炸弹爆炸的时候，我刚好就在现场。

bond.definition:
n. a certificate of debt (usually interest-bearing or discounted) that is issued by a government or corporation in order to raise money; the issuer is required to pay a fixed sum annually until maturity and then a fixed sum to repay the principal
n. a superior quality of strong durable white writing paper; originally made for printing documents
n. United States civil rights leader who was elected to the legislature in Georgia but was barred from taking his seat because he opposed the Vietnam War (born 1940)
n. British secret operative 007 in novels by Ian Fleming
bond.translation: n. 捆绑物, 结合, 债券, 契约, 粘合剂, 保证人, 键, 关栈保留\nvt. 存入关栈, 使黏合\nvi. 结合

examples.en: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
examples.zh: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。

examples.en: "I'd look like a real James Bond in that," Dima said to himself, then entered the store.
examples.zh: 狄马自言自语地说：「我穿上它，看起来就会像詹姆士庞德一样。」然后就走进了店子里。

bone.definition:
n. rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates
n. the porous calcified substance from which bones are made
n. a shade of white the color of bleached bones
v. remove the bones from
bone.translation: n. 骨头, 骨, 骨制品\nvt. 剔骨\nvi. 专心致志

examples.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
examples.zh: 冰冷的疾风吹到我骨子里去了。

examples.en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
examples.zh: 我被鱼骨刺到了喉咙。

examples.en: A fish bone has stuck in my throat.
examples.zh: 一根鱼刺卡在我嗓子里了。

bonus.definition: n. anything that tends to arouse\nn. an additional payment (or other remuneration) to employees as a means of increasing output
bonus.translation: n. 奖金, 红利\n[经] 奖金, 红利, 额外补贴

examples.en: I was disappointed that my bonus was less than usual.
Management tried to appease labor by offering them a bonus.
Employees will receive a bonus equivalent to six months' salary.

book.definition:
n. a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)
n. physical objects consisting of a number of pages bound together
n. a collection of playing cards satisfying the rules of a card game
n. a collection of rules or prescribed standards on the basis of which decisions are made
book.translation: n. 书, 书籍, 帐簿, 名册, 工作簿\nv. 登记, 预订\n[计] 工作簿

examples.en: I can't read such a thick book in a week.
examples.zh: 我不能在一个星期中读过这么厚厚的书。

examples.en: Was there a book on the desk a moment ago?
examples.zh: 刚才桌子上有一本书吗？

examples.en: Do you agree with what he says in the book?
examples.zh: 你赞成他在书中说的话吗？

booklet.definition: n. a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: This booklet is free of charge.
examples.zh: 这本小册子是免费的。

boom.definition:
n. a deep prolonged loud noise
n. a state of economic prosperity
n. a sudden happening that brings good fortune (as a sudden opportunity to make money)
n. a pole carrying an overhead microphone projected over a film or tv set
boom.translation: n. 繁荣, 隆隆声\nvi. 急速发展, 发隆隆声\nvt. 使兴旺, 发隆隆声

examples.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
examples.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

boost.definition:
n. the act of giving hope or support to someone
n. the act of giving a push
v. give a boost to; be beneficial to
v. increase or raise
boost.translation: n. 推进, 吹捧\nvt. 推进, 提高, 宣扬, 促进

examples.en: Ziri pushed Rima forward, giving her a boost of speed.
Can Algeria successfully attract FDIs and boost its economic growth?
The tax cut is supposed to boost capital investment.

boot.definition:
n. footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg
n. British term for the luggage compartment in a car
n. protective casing for something that resembles a leg
n. an instrument of torture that is used to heat or crush the foot and leg
boot.translation: n. 长靴, 踢, 解雇, 效用\nvt. 使穿靴, 踢, 解雇, 有用\n[计] 引导, 自举

examples.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
examples.zh: 我想买一双滑雪靴。

examples.en: He scraped the mud off his boots.
examples.zh: 他刮下靴子上的泥巴。

examples.en: She bought a pair of walking boots.
examples.zh: 她买了一双山地靴。

booth.definition:
n. a table (in a restaurant or bar) surrounded by two high-backed benches
n. small area set off by walls for special use
n. United States actor and assassin of President Lincoln (1838-1865)
n. a small shop at a fair; for selling goods or entertainment
booth.translation: n. 亭, 摊棚\n[经] 货摊, 电话间

examples.en: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
examples.zh: 汤姆跑啊跑, 直到他终于看到了电话亭。

examples.en: Telephone booths are as scarce as hen's teeth around here.
examples.zh: 这里附近的电话亭少得可怜。

examples.en: Where's the nearest telephone booth?
examples.zh: 最近的电话亭在哪里？

border.definition: n. a strip forming the outer edge of something\nv. provide with a border or edge\nv. lie adjacent to another or share a boundary
border.translation:
n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛
vt. 在...上镶边, 接近
vi. 接界, 近似
[计] 边框

examples.en: I was asked to show my passport at the border.
examples.zh: 在边境上，我被要求出示我的护照。

examples.en: Canada and Mexico both share a border with the USA.
examples.zh: 加拿大和墨西哥跟美国分享一个国境。

examples.en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
examples.zh: 边境上有一片农业区。

bore.definition:
n. a person who evokes boredom
n. diameter of a tube or gun barrel
n. a hole or passage made by a drill; usually made for exploratory purposes
v. cause to be bored
bore.translation:
n. 令人讨厌的人, 激浪, 枪膛, 孔
vt. 使烦扰, 钻孔
vi. 钻孔
bear的过去式
[计] 内径; 孔径

examples.en: I'll come and see you at 3:00 p.m. on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我星期天下午三时会来看你。

examples.en: If you're bored, I suggest you go to the cinema.
examples.zh: 如果你感到无聊，我建议你去电影院。

examples.en: I met her at 8:30p.m at the cathedral.
examples.zh: 我和她约了今晚八点半在大教堂见。

boring.definition: n. the act of drilling a hole in the earth in the hope of producing petroleum\ns. so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
boring.translation: a. 烦人的, 无聊的, 无趣的\n[机] 成孔期, 搪孔

examples.en: Nothing is more boring than traveling long distances by car.
examples.zh: 没有什么比坐长途汽车更无聊。

examples.en: She is the most boring girl I ever knew.
examples.zh: 她是我认识的最烦人的女孩。

examples.en: Do not talk nonsense, My job is very boring!
examples.zh: 不是瞎说，我这份工作真是没劲！

born.definition: n. British nuclear physicist (born in Germany) honored for his contributions to quantum mechanics (1882-1970)\na. brought into existence
born.translation: a. 天生的\nbear的过去分词

examples.en: As soon as man is born, he begins to die.
examples.zh: 从出生的一刻开始，我们就在步向死亡。

examples.en: I always knew I was born to do this work.
examples.zh: 我一直都知道我生来就是为了做这工作。

examples.en: I live in Boston, but I was born in Chicago.
examples.zh: 我住在波士顿，但我出生在芝加哥。

borrow.translation: vt. 借, 借入, 借用\nvi. 借\n[计] 借位; 借位数

examples.en: I don't dare ask the boss to borrow the car.
examples.zh: 我不敢问老板借车。

examples.en: Can I borrow a pen? Mine's on its last legs.
examples.zh: 能借枝笔吗？我这枝要不行了。

examples.en: Father ran short of money and had to borrow some.
examples.zh: 父亲缺钱，所以他必须去借点钱。

boss.definition: n. a person responsible for hiring workers\nn. a person who exercises control and makes decisions\ns. exceptionally good
boss.translation: n. 老板, 上司, 岩瘤, 浮雕, 母牛\nvt. 指挥, 控制, 浮雕

examples.en: He is our boss, and must be treated as such.
examples.zh: 他是我们的老板，所以一定要受到这样的礼待。

examples.en: I don't dare ask the boss to borrow the car.
examples.zh: 我不敢问老板借车。

examples.en: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
examples.zh: 在公开场合开你老板的玩笑是无礼的。

botany.definition: n. the branch of biology that studies plants
botany.translation: n. 植物学\n[医] 植物学

examples.en: Did you know that botany is the study of plants?
Zoology and botany are dedicated to the study of life.
Zoology and botany deal with the study of life.

both.definition: s. (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two
both.translation: a. 两者的\nadv. 两者都\npron. 两者

examples.en: We handle all type of books, both new and old.
examples.zh: 我们处理各种书籍，包括新的和旧的。

examples.en: Tom added both his and Mary's name to the list.
examples.zh: 汤姆将他自己和玛丽的名字添加到了名单上。
