examples.en: Tom sent both of his sons to a boarding school.
examples.zh: 汤姆把他的两个儿子都送到了寄宿学校。

bother.definition: v. intrude or enter uninvited\nv. make nervous or agitated\nv. make confused or perplexed or puzzled
bother.translation: vt. 烦扰, 迷惑\nvi. 烦恼, 操心\nn. 麻烦, 纠纷, 讨厌的人

examples.en: He didn't pass the exam, but it doesn't bother him.
examples.zh: 他考试没过，但他不是特别在意。

examples.en: I am sorry to bother you at this time.
examples.zh: 很抱歉在这个时间打扰您。

examples.en: Even if we end up being late, it doesn't bother us.
examples.zh: 如果我们迟到的话也没有什么问题。

bottle.definition:
n. a glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped
n. the quantity contained in a bottle
n. a vessel fitted with a flexible teat and filled with milk or formula; used as a substitute for breast feeding infants and very young children
v. store (liquids or gases) in bottles
bottle.translation: n. 瓶子, 酒瓶\nvt. 装瓶, 抑制, 围困

examples.en: There was only a little milk left in the bottle.
examples.zh: 瓶子里只剩下一丁点牛奶。

examples.en: In the depths of winter, a hot-water bottle is essential.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬天，热水袋是必不可少的。

examples.en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
examples.zh: 吃药之前一定要仔细看说明书。

bottom.definition:
n. the lower side of anything
n. the lowest part of anything
n. the second half of an inning; while the home team is at bat
n. a cargo ship
bottom.translation:
n. 底部
a. 底部的
vt. 给...装底, 查明真相
vi. 到达底部, 建立基础

examples.en: The others have already licked the bottom of the pot.
examples.zh: 其他人已经舔干净锅底了。

examples.en: Their child got their bottom smacked, because they wouldn't listen.
examples.zh: 他们家小孩因为不听话，被打了屁股。

examples.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
examples.zh: 我打心底里感激你。

boulder.definition: n. a large smooth mass of rock detached from its place of origin\nn. a town in north central Colorado; Rocky Mountains resort center and university town
boulder.translation: n. 大圆石\n[机] 圆石, 漂石

examples.en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
examples.zh: 海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

bounce.definition:
n. the quality of a substance that is able to rebound
n. rebounding from an impact (or series of impacts)
v. spring back; spring away from an impact
v. hit something so that it bounces
bounce.translation:
n. 跳, 跳跃, 弹力, 撞击
vi. 反跳, 弹跳
vt. 使跳回, 撞击
[计] 打回

examples.en: I'm surprised Tom hasn't bounced back by now.
examples.zh: 我很惊讶汤姆到现在还没有恢复过来。

examples.en: The billiard ball bounced off of three different sides of the table before landing in a side pocket.
examples.zh: 那颗撞球在桌面的三个边框上各回弹了一下，最后落入一个边袋。

bound.definition:
v. form the boundary of; be contiguous to
a. confined by bonds
a. held with another element, substance or material in chemical or physical union
a. secured with a cover or binding; often used as a combining form
bound.translation:
n. 跃, 回跳, 范围, 边界
a. 受约束的, 装有封面的, 有义务的, 关联的, 被束缚的, 准备去...的, 便秘的
vi. 跳跃, 弹起
vt. 使跳, 限制, 形成...的疆界
bind过去式和过去分词
[计] 装订的

examples.en: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
examples.zh: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。

examples.en: The plane bound for Beijing is going to take off soon.
examples.zh: 飞往北京的飞机就要起飞了。

examples.en: He boarded a plane bound for Los Angeles.
examples.zh: 他登上了前往洛杉矶的飞机。

boundary.definition: n. the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something\nn. a line determining the limits of an area
boundary.translation: n. 边界, 分界线\n[计] 边界

examples.en: I don't like people who have no sense of boundaries.
examples.zh: 我很讨厌没有边界感的人。

examples.en: Sebatik Island is one of the boundary regions between Indonesia and Malaysia.
examples.zh: Sebatik 岛是印度尼西亚和马来西亚的边境地区之一。

examples.en: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
examples.zh: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

bow.definition:
n. a knot with two loops and loose ends; used to tie shoelaces
n. a slightly curved piece of resilient wood with taut horsehair strands; used in playing certain stringed instruments
n. front part of a vessel or aircraft
n. a weapon for shooting arrows, composed of a curved piece of resilient wood with a taut cord to propel the arrow
bow.translation: n. 弓, 眼睛框\nv. 用弓拉琴, 弯成弓形\nn. 鞠躬, 屈服

examples.en: In Japan, it is polite to bow when one meets someone.
examples.zh: 在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有礼貌的表现。

examples.en: I walked up to her, bowed, and kissed her hand.
examples.zh: 我走到她身旁，鞠了个躬，亲吻她的手。

examples.en: The girl made an awkward bow.
examples.zh: 这个女孩做了一把很难使用的弓。

bowl.definition:
n. a round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids; 
n. a concave shape with an open top
n. a dish that is round and open at the top for serving foods
n. the quantity contained in a bowl
bowl.translation: n. 碗, 木球, 大酒杯\nv. 滚木球, 快而稳地行驶

examples.en: Don't fill up your bowl with too much food.
examples.zh: 饭勿要盛得满得很。

examples.en: Every morning I eat a bowl of oatmeal.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨吃一碗麦片粥。

examples.en: I'd like mapo tofu and two bowls of rice, please.
examples.zh: 我要麻婆豆腐，还有两碗米饭。

box.definition:
n. a (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid
n. private area in a theater or grandstand where a small group can watch the performance
n. the quantity contained in a box
n. a rectangular drawing
box.translation:
n. 盒子, 箱, 方框, 一巴掌
vt. 装...入盒中, 装箱, 打耳光
vi. 拳击
[计] 方框

examples.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.
examples.zh: 我想要个能装这些玩具的盒子。

examples.en: She was all eyes as he opened the jewelry box.
examples.zh: 她非常注意地看著他打开了珠宝盒。

examples.en: That box is too small to hold all these things.
examples.zh: 那个箱子太小了，装不下这么多的东西。

boy.definition: n. a friendly informal reference to a grown man\nn. (ethnic slur) offensive and disparaging term for Black man
boy.translation: n. 男孩\n[法] 男孩, 少年, 儿子

examples.en: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
examples.zh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。

examples.en: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.
examples.zh: 汤姆太老实了，连撒谎都不会。

examples.en: You remind me of a boy I used to know.
examples.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。

boycott.definition: n. a group's refusal to have commercial dealings with some organization in protest against its policies\nv. refuse to sponsor; refuse to do business with
boycott.translation: n. 联合抵制\nvt. 联合抵制

examples.en: The boycott lasted a little more than a year.
She tried to persuade him to organize a boycott.
We will prepare for a boycott against Western Samoa.

bracket.definition:
n. a category falling within certain defined limits
n. either of two punctuation marks (`<' or `>') used in computer programming and sometimes used to enclose textual material
n. either of two punctuation marks ([ or ]) used to enclose textual material
n. a support projecting from a wall (as to hold a shelf)
bracket.translation: n. 支架, 括弧, 托架\nvt. 装托架, 括入括弧\n[计] 方括号; 括号

examples.en: In my age bracket, there are no job offers available.
Her income puts her into the highest tax bracket.
Only one competitor can emerge from the crucible of losers' bracket.

brain.definition:
n. that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
n. mental ability
n. the brain of certain animals used as meat
v. hit on the head

examples.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
examples.zh: 随著人们年龄的增长，其脑细胞就变得比较没有效率。

examples.en: Idiot... You got water in your brain or something?
examples.zh: 白痴，你脑子进水了？

examples.en: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
examples.zh: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。

brake.definition:
n. a restraint used to slow or stop a vehicle
n. any of various ferns of the genus Pteris having pinnately compound leaves and including several popular houseplants
n. an area thickly overgrown usually with one kind of plant
n. anything that slows or hinders a process
brake.translation: n. 刹车, 阻碍, 丛林\nv. 刹车

examples.en: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
examples.zh: 刹车的功能是使车停下。

examples.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.
examples.zh: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。

examples.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.
examples.zh: 除非他们事先修好刹车，我才会买车子。

branch.definition:
n. a division of some larger or more complex organization
n. a division of a stem, or secondary stem arising from the main stem of a plant
n. a part of a forked or branching shape
n. a stream or river connected to a larger one
branch.translation:
n. 树枝, 支店, 支流, 分部
vi. 分支, 出枝
vt. 分割, 用枝状叶脉刺绣花纹装饰
[计] 分支, 目录分支

examples.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
examples.zh: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。

examples.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
examples.zh: 新的分店下个月在芝加哥开始营业。

examples.en: The blue bird is perched on a branch, singing cheerfully.
examples.zh: 蓝色的鸟栖息在树枝上，兴致昂扬地唱着歌。

brand.definition:
n. a recognizable kind
n. identification mark on skin, made by burning
n. a piece of wood that has been burned or is burning
v. burn with a branding iron to indicate ownership; of animals
brand.translation: n. 商标, 牌子, 烙印\nvt. 打烙印于

examples.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
examples.zh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

examples.en: I want a reliable brand that has good reviews.
examples.zh: 我想要备受好评的可靠品牌。

examples.en: Which brand of toilet paper do you usually buy?
examples.zh: 你通常买哪家的手纸呢？

brass.definition:
n. an alloy of copper and zinc
n. a wind instrument that consists of a brass tube (usually of variable length) that is blown by means of a cup-shaped or funnel-shaped mouthpiece
n. an ornament or utensil made of brass
n. a memorial made of brass
brass.translation: n. 黄铜, 黄铜制品\na. 黄铜的, 铜管乐器的\nv. 镀以黄铜, 支付

examples.en: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
examples.zh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。

examples.en: A brass band is marching along the street.
examples.zh: 一个铜管乐队沿着路前进。

examples.en: Gold is similar in color to brass.
examples.zh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。

brave.definition:
n. a North American Indian warrior
n. people who are brave
a. possessing or displaying courage; able to face and deal with danger or fear without flinching
s. brightly colored and showy
brave.translation: a. 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的\nn. 勇敢者\nvt. 勇敢地面对

examples.en: John is brave in appearance, but is in reality a coward.
examples.zh: 约翰看起来很勇敢，但其实是个胆小鬼。

examples.en: We know him to be a brave man.
examples.zh: 我们知道他是个勇敢的人。

examples.en: Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.
examples.zh: 几位见义勇为的乘客把小偷抓住了，还把他送到了警方的手中。

breach.definition: n. a failure to perform some promised act or obligation\nn. an opening (especially a gap in a dike or fortification)
breach.translation: n. 裂口, 违背, 破坏, 违反, 突破, 破裂\nvt. 攻破, 突破\nvi. 跳出水面

examples.en: More than 28 million Canadians were affected by privacy breaches last year.
examples.zh: 去年，超过2800万加拿大人被隐私泄露受到影响了。

bread.definition: n. food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked\nv. cover with bread crumbs
bread.translation: n. 面包, 生计, 食物\nvt. 裹以面包屑

examples.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房有烤箱，可以用来烤面包。

examples.en: Is there a difference between steamed buns and steamed bread?
examples.zh: 馒头和馍馍有区别吗？

examples.en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
examples.zh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

breadth.definition: n. the capacity to understand a broad range of topics
breadth.translation: n. 宽度\n[法] 违背, 违犯, 未遵守

examples.en: I missed the train by a hair's breadth.
examples.zh: 我以一分之差错过了那趟火车。

examples.en: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
examples.zh: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

break.definition:
n. an unexpected piece of good luck
n. the occurrence of breaking
n. an abrupt change in the tone or register of the voice (as at puberty or due to emotion)
n. the opening shot that scatters the balls in billiards or pool
break.translation:
n. 休息, 中断, 破裂处, 绝交, 破晓, 突变
vt. 打破, 弄破, 弄坏, 破坏, 违反, 打断, 削弱, 放弃
vi. 破碎, 决裂, 破晓, 突变, 变弱, 暂停
n. 分隔符
[计] 分隔符; 中断; DOS内部命令:设定扫描中断按键的时机

examples.en: I wonder if a third world war will break out.
examples.zh: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。

examples.en: I think that you should break up with your boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我觉得你应该跟男友分手。

examples.en: I have been writing since two o'clock without a break.
examples.zh: 我从两点开始写呀写呀，一分钟也没休息过。

breakdown.definition: n. a mental or physical breakdown\nn. a cessation of normal operation\nn. an analysis into mutually exclusive categories
breakdown.translation: n. 崩溃, 故障\n[化] 事故; 击穿

examples.en: As a result of the server breakdown, total PV of yesterday dropped by 30% compared with normal.
examples.zh: 由于服务器故障，昨天的总PV与正常相比下降了30%。

breakfast.definition: n. the first meal of the day (usually in the morning)\nv. eat an early morning meal\nv. provide breakfast for

examples.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
examples.zh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。

examples.en: It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我习惯早餐之前出去散步。

examples.en: I've woken up and I intend to prepare my breakfast.
examples.zh: 我醒来，打算准备早饭。

breakthrough.definition: n. making an important discovery\nn. a penetration of a barrier such as an enemy's defense
breakthrough.translation: n. 突破\n[经] 突破, 新发现, 新进展

examples.en: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
examples.zh: 多数科学突破只不过是发现了显而易见的事。

breast.definition:
n. the front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen
n. either of two soft fleshy milk-secreting glandular organs on the chest of a woman
n. meat carved from the breast of a fowl
n. the part of an animal's body that corresponds to a person's chest
breast.translation: n. 胸部, 乳房, 胸怀\nvt. 以胸对着, 面对

examples.en: I'd like to have a test for breast cancer.
examples.zh: 我想检查一下我是否患了乳癌。

examples.en: Tom eats rice every day either with fish or with chicken breast.
examples.zh: 汤姆每天吃饭要嘛配鱼，要嘛配鸡胸肉。

examples.en: He doesn't drink enough breast milk.
examples.zh: 他母乳喝得不够。

breath.definition:
n. the process of taking in and expelling air during breathing
n. the air that is inhaled and exhaled in respiration
n. a short respite
n. a slight movement of the air
breath.translation: n. 呼吸, 气息, 瞬间\n[医] 呼气, 呵气, 口气, 呼吸

examples.en: He ran so fast that he was out of breath.
examples.zh: 他跑得太快，以至于喘不过气来。

examples.en: He said to her under his breath, "I love you."
examples.zh: 他压低嗓门对她说：「我爱你。」

examples.en: He took a deep breath before entering his boss's office.
examples.zh: 他在进老板办公室前深吸了一口气。

breathe.definition:
v. draw air into, and expel out of, the lungs
v. be alive
v. impart as if by breathing
v. allow the passage of air through
breathe.translation: vi. 呼吸, 生存, 低语\nvt. 呼吸, 使喘息, 发散, 低声说

examples.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
examples.zh: 我们呼吸的空气是由氧气和氮气组成的。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a dragon that can't breathe fire.
examples.zh: 书里讲的是一条不会喷火的龙的故事。

examples.en: I want to breathe some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我想呼吸一下新鲜空气。

breed.definition:
n. a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
n. a special type
v. copulate with a female, used especially of horses
v. cause to procreate (animals)
breed.translation: n. 种类, 品种\nv. 养育, 引起, 饲养, 繁殖

examples.en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 数月后，牠们回到了北极的繁殖地。

examples.en: Clear water breeds no fish.
examples.zh: 水至清则无鱼。

examples.en: In England, parks taking rare breeds of animals as their theme are becoming increasingly popular with people.
examples.zh: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。

breeze.definition: n. a slight wind (usually refreshing)\nv. blow gently and lightly\nv. to proceed quickly and easily
breeze.translation: n. 微风, 煤屑, 轻而易举的事\nvi. 吹微风, 逃走

examples.en: A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 微风吹荡着湖面。

examples.en: Her golden hair floats in the summer breeze.
examples.zh: 她的一头金发在夏日的微风中飘荡。

examples.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
examples.zh: 柳枝在微风中轻轻荡悠。

bribe.definition: n. payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment\nv. make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
bribe.translation: n. 贿赂\nvt. 贿赂, 收买\nvi. 行贿

examples.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
examples.zh: 该法案的说客把游说贿款汇入了竞选基金。

examples.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.
examples.zh: 市长否认收受了贿赂。

examples.en: The old man bribed a young girl with money and jewelry.
examples.zh: 老人用金钱和珠宝取得了少女的欢心。

brick.definition: n. rectangular block of clay baked by the sun or in a kiln; used as a building or paving material\nn. a good fellow; helpful and trustworthy
brick.translation: n. 砖块, 积木\na. 用砖做的\nvt. 用砖造, 用砖砌

examples.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
examples.zh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

examples.en: Put your hard hat on. You might well get a brick fall on your head here.
examples.zh: 把安全帽戴上。这里很可能会有砖块砸到你头上。

bride.definition: n. a woman who has recently been married\nn. a woman participant in her own marriage ceremony

examples.en: According to custom, the bride should be compliant.
examples.zh: 根据习俗，新娘应该循规蹈矩。

examples.en: The bride seems to be very pretty.
examples.zh: 新娘好像非常漂亮。

examples.en: The groom works for a company now, and the bride is our teacher.
examples.zh: 新郎现在在一家公司工作，新娘是我们的老师。

bridge.definition:
n. a structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.
n. a circuit consisting of two branches (4 arms arranged in a diamond configuration) across which a meter is connected
n. something resembling a bridge in form or function
n. the hard ridge that forms the upper part of the nose
bridge.translation: n. 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌\nvt. 架桥于, 跨越\n[计] 桥, 网桥, 桥接器

examples.en: His plan is to build a bridge over that river.
examples.zh: 他的计划是在那条河上建一座桥。

examples.en: A large amount of money was spent on the bridge.
examples.zh: 建这条桥花了不少钱。

examples.en: This is longer than any other bridge in the world.
examples.zh: 这是世界上最长的大桥。

brief.definition:
n. a document stating the facts and points of law of a client's case
n. a condensed written summary or abstract
v. give essential information to someone
s. of short duration or distance
brief.translation: n. 摘要, 简报\na. 简短的, 短暂的\nvt. 对...作简报, 摘要, 节录

examples.en: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
examples.zh: 你能简短地介绍一下你自己吗？

examples.en: Let's take a brief look at this topic.
examples.zh: 让我们来简单地了解一下这个课题。

examples.en: He gave his reasons in brief.
examples.zh: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。

bright.definition:
a. emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts
s. having striking color
s. characterized by quickness and ease in learning
s. having lots of light either natural or artificial
bright.translation: a. 明亮的, 聪明的, 鲜明的, 欢快的\nadv. 明亮地, 欢快地

examples.en: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
examples.zh: 我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。

examples.en: He was bright like the 4th of July! "Wow!", I thought!
examples.zh: 他就像七月四日的烟火一样耀眼！我心想：「哇！」

examples.en: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.
examples.zh: 我一喝了酒就立刻变得通红。

brilliant.definition: s. of surpassing excellence\ns. characterized by grandeur\ns. full of light; shining intensely
brilliant.translation: a. 光辉的, 灿烂的, 有才气的\n[机] 亮的

examples.en: A brilliant, seductive chef turns to espionage in Napoleon-era France.
examples.zh: 拿破仑时代的法国，魅力诱人的天才厨师摇身一变成为间谍。

examples.en: Brilliant people have one major drawback - they don't know how to lose.
examples.zh: 天才们有一个重要的缺点：他们不会输。

examples.en: How can one achieve such brilliant results?
examples.zh: 这样辉煌的成绩，是如何取得的？

bring.definition:
v. take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
v. cause to come into a particular state or condition
v. cause to happen or to occur as a consequence
v. go or come after and bring or take back
bring.translation: vt. 带来, 产生, 促使, 提出\nvi. 生产

examples.en: Do I have to bring my son to your office?
examples.zh: 我必须带我的儿子到你的办公室吗？

examples.en: I suggested that we bring the meeting to an end.
examples.zh: 我建议让我们结束会议。

examples.en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
examples.zh: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？

brisk.translation: a. 强烈的, 寒冷而干燥的, 活泼的\nvt. 使活泼\nvi. 活跃起来

examples.en: Sales were brisk during the holiday season but have dropped off since.
examples.zh: 假期期间销售业绩畅旺，但之后就下滑了。

brittle.definition:
n. caramelized sugar cooled in thin sheets
s. having little elasticity; hence easily cracked or fractured or snapped
s. lacking warmth and generosity of spirit
s. (of metal or glass) not annealed and consequently easily cracked or fractured
brittle.translation: a. 易碎的, 脆弱的, 易坏的\n[机] 脆的, 脆性的, 易碎的

examples.en: I don't like peanut brittle. I love it!
Metals can become brittle at low temperatures.
This glass is brittle.

broad.definition:
n. slang term for a woman
s. not detailed or specific
s. lacking subtlety; obvious
s. being at a peak or culminating point
broad.translation: a. 宽广的, 辽阔的, 广大的, 显著的\nadv. 宽阔地\nn. 宽阔部分

examples.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
examples.zh: 他的车子光天化日被偷走了。

examples.en: Today, robbers robbed another bank in broad daylight.
examples.zh: 今天强盗大白天的就抢了另一家银行。

examples.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.
examples.zh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。

broadcast.definition: n. message that is transmitted by radio or television\nn. a radio or television show\nv. sow over a wide area, especially by hand
broadcast.translation:
n. 广播, 传播
a. 广播的
v. 广播
adv. 经广播, 四散地
[计] 广播命令, 广播

examples.en: His death was broadcast all over the world.
examples.zh: 他去世的消息在世界各地播出。

examples.en: We broadcast news on the hour.
examples.zh: 我们正点播报新闻。

examples.en: That program is now being broadcast.
examples.zh: 那个节目现在正在播出。

broaden.translation: vi. 变宽, 扩大\nvt. 放宽, 使扩大

examples.en: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
examples.zh: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。

brochure.definition: n a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: Could you send me a brochure?
examples.zh: 你能寄宣传册给我吗？

bronze.definition:
n. an alloy of copper and tin and sometimes other elements; also any copper-base alloy containing other elements in place of tin
n. a sculpture made of bronze
v. give the color and appearance of bronze to something
s. of the color of bronze
bronze.translation: n. 青铜, 铜像\na. 青铜色的

examples.en: The 5 yen coin is made from brass and the 10 yen coin is made from bronze.
examples.zh: 5元硬币是黄铜做的，10元硬币是青铜做的。

examples.en: The five yuan coins are brass, and the ten yuan coins are made out of bronze.
examples.zh: 5元硬币是黄铜做的，10元硬币是青铜做的。

examples.en: In Olympic competitions, the gold medal represents first place, the silver medal represents second place, and the bronze medal represents third place.
examples.zh: 在奥运会的竞赛中，金牌代表第一名，银牌代表第二名，铜牌是第三名。

brood.definition:
n. the young of an animal cared for at one time
v. think moodily or anxiously about something
v. hang over, as of something threatening, dark, or menacing
v. sit on (eggs)
brood.translation: n. 一窝, 一伙\nvt. 孵, 沉思

examples.en: A brood mare is a female horse used for breeding.
The hen has been brooding its eggs for a week.
You are not brooding and existing in your own head.

broom.definition: n. a cleaning implement for sweeping; bundle of straws or twigs attached to a long handle\nn. any of various shrubs of the genera Cytisus or Genista or Spartium having long slender branches and racemes of yellow flowers\nv. finish with a broom
broom.translation: n. 扫帚, 金雀花\nvt. 扫除

examples.en: I can't find the broom.
examples.zh: 我找不到扫把了。

examples.en: A new broom sweeps clean.
examples.zh: 新官上任三把火。

examples.en: She brought a broom.
examples.zh: 她拿来了一个扫把。

brother.definition:
n. a male with the same parents as someone else
n. a male person who is a fellow member (of a fraternity or religion or other group)
n. used as a term of address for those male persons engaged in the same movement
n. (Roman Catholic Church) a title given to a monk and used as form of address

examples.en: My brother fell from the tree and broke his leg.
examples.zh: 我的弟弟(或者哥哥)从树上掉下来摔断了腿。

examples.en: You seem to have mistaken me for my elder brother.
examples.zh: 你似乎把我当成我哥哥了。

examples.en: A good neighbour is better than a brother far off.
examples.zh: 远亲不如近邻。

brown.definition:
n. an orange of low brightness and saturation
n. Scottish botanist who first observed the movement of small particles in fluids now known a Brownian motion (1773-1858)
n. abolitionist who was hanged after leading an unsuccessful raid at Harper's Ferry, Virginia (1800-1859)
v. fry in a pan until it changes color
brown.translation: n. 褐色\na. 褐色的\nv. (使)变褐色

examples.en: The quick brown fox didn't jump over the lazy dog.
examples.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸没有跃过懒洋洋的狗。

examples.en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
examples.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

examples.en: Which do you like better, white rice or brown rice?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢白米还是糙米呢？

browse.definition:
n. vegetation (such as young shoots, twigs, and leaves) that is suitable for animals to eat
n. reading superficially or at random
n. the act of feeding by continual nibbling
v. look around casually and randomly, without seeking anything in particular
browse.translation: v. 浏览, 吃草\nn. 浏览, 吃草\n[计] 浏览

examples.en: I'm just browsing.
examples.zh: 我只是浏览一下。

brush.definition:
n. a dense growth of bushes
n. an implement that has hairs or bristles firmly set into a handle
n. momentary contact
n. conducts current between rotating and stationary parts of a generator or motor
brush.translation:
n. 刷子, 毛笔, 争吵
vt. 刷
vi. 擦过, 掠过
[计] 电刷

examples.en: She studied abroad in order to brush up her English.
examples.zh: 她在国外学习以便提升她的英语。

examples.en: Recently, I want to go to brush my teeth.
examples.zh: 我最近想去洗个牙。

examples.en: Most people brush their teeth at least two times a day.
examples.zh: 多数人每天至少刷两次牙。

brutal.definition: s. harsh\ns. disagreeably direct and precise
brutal.translation: a. 残忍的, 野蛮的, 不讲理的

examples.en: "Tom chopped up the manuscript like it was iceberg lettuce." "Sounds brutal." "It was, but it was also necessary."
examples.zh: 「汤姆像切卷心莴苣一样，把手稿切碎了。」「听起来很残忍。」「没错，而且也没有那个必要。」

brute.definition: n a cruelly rapacious person\nn a living organism characterized by voluntary movement\ns resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility
brute.translation: n. 畜生, 残忍或好色之人\na. 残忍的, 无理性的, 畜生的

examples.en: They will try to beat us with brute force.
Ziri was banging on the door with brute force.
I memorized the fact sheet through sheer brute force.

bubble.definition:
n. a hollow globule of gas (e.g., air or carbon dioxide)
n. an impracticable and illusory idea
n. a dome-shaped covering made of transparent glass or plastic
v. form, produce, or emit bubbles
bubble.translation: n. 泡沫\nvi. 冒泡, 沸腾\nvt. 使冒泡, 滔滔不绝地说

examples.en: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
examples.zh: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。

bucket.definition:
n. a roughly cylindrical vessel that is open at the top
n. the quantity contained in a bucket
v. put into a bucket
v. carry in a bucket
bucket.translation: n. 桶\n[计] 存储桶; 桶

examples.en: Well, I can cross that off my bucket list.
examples.zh: 太好了，死前心愿又完成了一样。

examples.en: This bucket has a hole in it.
examples.zh: 这个桶有个洞。

examples.en: He collected an entire bucket of water.
examples.zh: 他打了一整桶水。

bud.definition:
n. a partially opened flower
n. a swelling on a plant stem consisting of overlapping immature leaves or petals
v. develop buds
v. start to grow or develop
bud.translation: n. 芽, 花蕾\nvi. 发芽, 萌芽\nvt. 使发芽

examples.en: The trees have begun to bud.
examples.zh: 树木开始抽芽。

examples.en: The trees are beginning to bud.
examples.zh: 树木开始抽芽。

examples.en: Taste buds are very useful.
examples.zh: 味蕾很有用。

budge.definition: n. United States tennis player who in 1938 was the first to win the Australian and French and English and United States singles championship in the same year (1915-2000)
budge.translation: vi. 微微移动\nvt. 推动\nn. 羔羊皮

examples.en: It won't budge one bit.
examples.zh: 扛不动它。

budget.definition: n. a sum of money allocated for a particular purpose\nn. a summary of intended expenditures along with proposals for how to meet them\nv. make a budget
budget.translation:
n. 预算
vi. 编预算
vt. 编入预算, 安排
a. 廉价的

examples.en: We are traveling on a tight budget.
examples.zh: 我们很节省地旅行。

examples.en: The price should fit my budget.
examples.zh: 价格应该符合预算。

examples.en: We're traveling on a tight budget.
examples.zh: 我们用少的预算旅行。

buff.definition:
n. a soft thick undyed leather from the skins of e.g. buffalo or oxen
n. bare skin; naked
n. an implement consisting of soft material mounted on a block; used for polishing (as in manicuring)
v. polish and make shiny
buff.translation: n. 暗黄色, 暗黄色皮革, 人的皮肤\nvt. 擦亮, 使柔软\na. 暗黄色的

examples.en: Let's play a game of blind man's buff.
examples.zh: 咱们玩儿捉迷藏吧。

examples.en: They are film buffs.
examples.zh: 他们都是电影爱好者。

buffer.definition:
n. (chemistry) an ionic compound that resists changes in its pH
n. (computer science) a part of RAM used for temporary storage of data that is waiting to be sent to a device; used to compensate for differences in the rate of flow of data between components of a computer system
n. a power tool used to buff surfaces
n. a cushion-like device that reduces shock due to an impact
buffer.translation: n. 缓冲器, 缓冲区\nvt. 缓冲\n[计] 缓冲区, 缓冲器

examples.en: During the Great Game, Afghanistan was a buffer state.
examples.zh: 在大博弈期间，阿富汗是一个缓冲国。

bug.definition: n. general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate\nn. a fault or defect in a computer program, system, or machine\nn. a small hidden microphone; for listening secretly
bug.translation:
n. 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人
vt. 装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒
vi. 捉虫, 暴突
[计] 缺点, 错误

examples.en: We're thoroughly prepared for the Y2K bug.
examples.zh: 我们已经准备好应付千年虫。

examples.en: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
examples.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

examples.en: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
examples.zh: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。

build.definition:
v. build or establish something abstract
v. improve the cleansing action of
v. order, supervise, or finance the construction of
v. give form to, according to a plan
build.translation: v. 建立, 建筑\nn. 构造, 体格

examples.en: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
examples.zh: 盖我自己的房子超出了我的能力范围。

examples.en: His goal in buying land is to build a house.
examples.zh: 他买土地的目的是要造房子。

examples.en: His plan is to build a bridge over that river.
examples.zh: 他的计划是在那条河上建一座桥。

building.definition: n. a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place\nn. the occupants of a building
building.translation: n. 建筑物, 建筑\n[法] 营造, 建筑, 建筑物

examples.en: They will tear down the old building in two days.
examples.zh: 他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧的建筑物。

examples.en: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?
examples.zh: 我们可以在大楼里拍照吗？

examples.en: Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire.
examples.zh: 你看，那边正在冒烟，那栋大厦一定是失火了。

bulge.definition:
n. something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
v. swell or protrude outwards
v. bulge out; form a bulge outward, or be so full as to appear to bulge
v. cause to bulge or swell outwards
bulge.translation: n. 胀, 膨胀\nvi. 凸出\nvt. 使膨胀

examples.en: Her pockets were bulging with walnuts.
examples.zh: 她的口袋里塞满了核桃。

bulk.definition: n. the property of something that is great in magnitude\nn. the property possessed by a large mass\nv. stick out or up
bulk.translation: n. 大小, 体积, 大块, 大多数\nvt. 显得大, 显得重要

examples.en: The bulk of his work is in the urban area.
If you buy in bulk, you can get a discount.
I sell rice in bulk or packed in 1 kilogram bags.

bullet.definition: n. a projectile that is fired from a gun
bullet.translation: n. 子弹\n[医] 弹, 子弹, 距节(马)

examples.en: He had three bullet wounds in his chest.
examples.zh: 他胸口中了三枪。

examples.en: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
examples.zh: 汤姆穿著一件防弹衣，所以子弹没把他杀死。

examples.en: He was killed by a single bullet.
examples.zh: 他被一颗子弹打死了。

bulletin.definition: n. a brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)\nv. make public by bulletin
bulletin.translation: n. 公告, 布告, 公报\n[电] 电子布告栏

examples.en: See the evening news bulletin for a report about this.
The new constitution will also be published in a bulletin.
Was there a need to air that news bulletin?

bully.definition: n. a cruel and brutal fellow\nn. a hired thug
bully.translation:
n. 欺凌弱小者, 土霸
vt. 威胁, 恐吓, 欺负
vi. 欺负
a. 特好的, 第一流的
adv. 十分

examples.en: The bully stomped on his schoolmate’s lunchbox out of spite.
examples.zh: 恶霸恶劣地践踏同学的午餐便当。

examples.en: You're bullying someone smaller than you again!
examples.zh: 你又在欺负弱小了！

examples.en: He always gets bullied at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校老是被人欺负。

bump.definition: n. a lump on the body caused by a blow\nv. knock against with force or violence\nv. dance erotically or dance with the pelvis thrust forward
bump.translation: n. 撞击, 肿块\nvt. 碰撞\nvi. 撞, 颠簸而行

examples.en: Tom bumped his head on the roof of the car.
examples.zh: 汤姆把头撞到车顶了。

examples.en: I bumped into an old friend on the bus.
examples.zh: 我偶然在巴士上碰见了一位旧朋友。

examples.en: The man I bumped into yesterday was Mr. Hill.
examples.zh: 我昨天碰到的男人是Hill先生。

bunch.definition: n. a grouping of a number of similar things\nn. any collection in its entirety\nv. gather or cause to gather into a cluster
bunch.translation: n. 串, 束\n[医] 骨肿块(马)

examples.en: He foisted a bunch of hard work on me.
examples.zh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。

examples.en: He dropped a bunch of hard tasks on me.
examples.zh: 他把那么难做的活儿丢给我。

examples.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
examples.zh: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。

bundle.definition: n. a package of several things tied together for carrying or storing\nv. make into a bundle\nv. sleep fully clothed in the same bed with one's betrothed
bundle.translation: n. 捆, 束\nvt. 包扎, 胡乱塞进\nvi. 匆忙离开

examples.en: He put a rubber band around the bundle of letters.
You must have dropped a bundle for that wedding ring!
They're paying me a bundle to try their newest products.

buoy.definition:
n. bright-colored; a float attached by rope to the seabed to mark channels in a harbor or underwater hazards
v. float on the surface of water
v. keep afloat
v. mark with a buoy
buoy.translation: n. 浮标, 航标, 救生圈\nvt. 使浮起, 鼓励

examples.en: The yacht sailed around a buoy.
examples.zh: 游艇绕浮标航行。

burden.definition: n. an onerous or difficult concern\nn. the central idea that is expanded in a document or discourse\nv. weight down with a load
burden.translation: n. 负担, 重载, 担子, 责任\nvt. 装货于, 烦扰, 使负担

examples.en: Seeing those tasks, I did not feel the burden.
examples.zh: 看到这些作业，我毫无压力。

examples.en: I know I'm a burden; you don't have to repeat it.
examples.zh: 我知道自己是个累赘，你没必要反复提。

examples.en: That responsibility is a burden to him.
examples.zh: 那个责任对他是个负担。

bureau.definition: n an administrative unit of government\nn furniture with drawers for keeping clothes
bureau.translation: n. 局, 办公处\n[经] 局, 司, 处

examples.en: Leave the bike here, and tomorrow bring your ID and 20 dollars to the Bureau of Communications to get the bike back.
examples.zh: 你们把自行车留下，明天带着身份证和20块钱到交通局领自行车。

bureaucracy.definition: n. nonelective government officials\nn. a government that is administered primarily by bureaus that are staffed with nonelective officials\nn. any organization in which action is obstructed by insistence on unnecessary procedures and red tape
bureaucracy.translation: n. 官僚, 官吏\n[法] 官僚主义, 官僚政治, 官僚机构

examples.en: Algeria needs to get rid of its bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要摆脱官僚主义。

burn.definition:
n. pain that feels hot as if it were on fire
n. an injury caused by exposure to heat or chemicals or radiation
n. a place or area that has been burned (especially on a person's body)
n. damage inflicted by fire
burn.translation: vt. 烧, 烧毁, 烧伤\nvi. 燃烧, 发热, 烧毁\nn. 烧伤, 烙印

examples.en: He lost his reason when he saw his house burn down.
examples.zh: 看着自己的房子被烧得精光，他顿时丧失了理智。

examples.en: When you have finished reading this letter, burn it.
examples.zh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。

examples.en: Burn that bridge when one comes to it.
examples.zh: 过河拆桥。

burst.definition:
n. a sudden flurry of activity (often for no obvious reason)
v. come open suddenly and violently, as if from internal pressure
v. move suddenly, energetically, or violently
v. emerge suddenly
burst.translation: n. 破裂, 突发, 爆发\nv. 爆裂, 突发, 充满\n[计] 二进制位组; 字符组; 脉冲串

examples.en: The moment she saw me, she burst out crying.
examples.zh: 她一看到我就开始哭了。

examples.en: Hardly had he entered the room, when she burst into tears.
examples.zh: 他刚进房间，她就泣不成声了。

examples.en: The water mains burst due to the earthquake.
examples.zh: 一条主要水管被地震震裂了。

bury.definition:
v. cover from sight
v. place in a grave or tomb
v. place in the earth and cover with soil
v. embed deeply

examples.en: You can only bury these deeply in your heart.
examples.zh: 只能把这些深深地埋在心里。

examples.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.
examples.zh: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。

examples.en: They buried him in the graveyard by the church.
examples.zh: 他们把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓园。

bus.definition:
n. a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport
n. a car that is old and unreliable
v. send or move around by bus
v. ride in a bus
bus.translation: n. 公共汽车\n[计] 总线; 汇流条; 母线

examples.en: An old man sat next to me on the bus.
examples.zh: 巴士上有个老人坐在我旁边。

examples.en: Could you tell me where I can get a bus?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我能在哪里上公交车吗？

examples.en: Do you go to school by bus on rainy days?
examples.zh: 下雨天你坐公车上学吗？

bush.definition:
n. a large wilderness area
n. 43rd President of the United States; son of George Herbert Walker Bush (born in 1946)
n. United States electrical engineer who designed an early analogue computer and who led the scientific program of the United States during World War II (1890-1974)
n. vice president under Reagan and 41st President of the United States (born in 1924)
bush.translation: n. 矮树丛\n[化] 管衬

examples.en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
examples.zh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

examples.en: Every bush and tree looks like an enemy.
examples.zh: 草木皆兵。

examples.en: A bird in the hand is better than two in the bush.
examples.zh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。

business.definition:
n. a commercial or industrial enterprise and the people who constitute it
n. a rightful concern or responsibility
n. an immediate objective
n. the volume of commercial activity
business.translation: n. 生意, 事情, 业务, 商业, 商行, 职责\n[经] 企业, 商业, 营业

examples.en: I'm sure he will go far in the business world.
examples.zh: 我坚信他在商业界会有所作为。

examples.en: From time to time, he goes to Tokyo on business.
examples.zh: 他时不时地因为工作去东京。

examples.en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
examples.zh: 我的生意终于走上了正轨。

busy.definition:
v. keep busy with
a. actively or fully engaged or occupied
s. overcrowded or cluttered with detail
s. crowded with or characterized by much activity
busy.translation:
a. 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的
vt. 使忙
vi. 忙碌
[计] 忙; 忙碌

examples.en: I wonder if you are as busy as we are.
examples.zh: 我担心你会跟我们一样忙。

examples.en: She is busy at present and can't speak to you.
examples.zh: 她现在很忙，不能和你谈话。

examples.en: I can't go with you today because I'm very busy.
examples.zh: 今天我太忙了，没法和你一起去。

but.translation: prep. 除了\nconj. 但是\nadv. 仅仅

examples.en: He is poor, to be sure, but he is happy.
examples.zh: 他确实很穷，但是他很幸福。

examples.en: I used to smoke a lot, but now I've quit.
examples.zh: 我以前常抽烟，但现在我戒掉了。

examples.en: People do not live to eat but eat to live.
examples.zh: 人为生而食，非为食而活。

butter.definition: n. an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use\nn. a fighter who strikes the opponent with his head\nv. spread butter on
butter.translation: n. 奶油, 黄油\nvt. 涂黄油于

examples.en: To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
examples.zh: 要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。

examples.en: The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
examples.zh: 这家店卖的是牛油、奶酪、砂糖之类的食品。

examples.en: I like to eat honey and peanut butter sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜花生酱三明治。

button.definition:
n. a round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes
n. any of various plant parts that resemble buttons
n. a round flat badge displaying information and suitable for pinning onto a garment
n. any artifact that resembles a button
button.translation:
n. 钮扣, 按钮
vi. 扣住
vt. 钉钮扣于, 扣紧
[计] 按钮

examples.en: Press this red button in case of an accident.
examples.zh: 发生意外的话按这个红按钮。

examples.en: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
examples.zh: 你衬衫的第二粒衣钮好像快要掉下来了。

examples.en: If you press this button the window opens automatically.
examples.zh: 按下这个按钮, 窗口会自动打开。

buy.definition:
v. obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction
v. be worth or be capable of buying
v. acquire by trade or sacrifice or exchange
v. accept as true
buy.translation: vt. 买, 获得\nvi. 买\nn. 购买, 买得的东西

examples.en: I'd buy a new house if I had the money.
examples.zh: 如果我有钱，我会买一个新房子。

examples.en: You can buy it for a thousand yen or so.
examples.zh: 你能以大约1000日元买下它。

examples.en: I think it's time for me to buy a house.
examples.zh: 我想我该是时候买间房子了。

buyer.translation: n. 买主, 买方\n[经] 买主, 买方, 买手

examples.en: I will sell it as soon as I find a buyer.
examples.zh: 我一找到买家就会把它卖掉。

by.definition: r. so as to pass a given point
by.translation: prep. 被, 经, 由, 在...之旁\nadv. 经过, 在近处

examples.en: That's why I told you not to go by car.
examples.zh: 这就是我叫你别乘车去的原因。

examples.en: How much will it cost you to go by air?
examples.zh: 坐飞机将花你多少钱？

examples.en: Do you go to school by bus on rainy days?
examples.zh: 下雨天你坐公车上学吗？

backdrop.definition: n. scenery hung at back of stage

examples.en: The starlit sky was a backdrop to Adriano's romantic proposal.
This waterfall is an amazing backdrop for pictures.
Robert went crashing into the backdrop.

backlash.definition: n. an adverse reaction to some political or social occurrence
backlash.translation: n. 后冲, 强烈反对\n[电] 反撞, 逆栅流

examples.en: Mennad was afraid of the backlash he was going to get.
His speech provoked a backlash from European leaders, writers and academics.
The bribery scandal created a backlash overseas.

baffle.definition: n. a flat plate that controls or directs the flow of fluid or energy\nv. check the emission of (sound)
baffle.translation: vt. 困惑, 为难, 使挫折\nvi. 徒作挣扎\nn. 迷惑, 挡板

examples.en: At the same time Ismo jumps and baffles the attendants.
I wonder if Tom and Mary are still baffled.
I wonder whether Tom and Mary are still baffled.

bait.definition:
n. anything that serves as an enticement
n. something used to lure fish or other animals into danger so they can be trapped or killed
v. lure, entice, or entrap with bait
v. attack with dogs or set dogs upon
bait.translation: n. 饵\nvt. 以饵引诱, 欺负\nvi. 中途休息

examples.en: Before he went fishing, he dug up some worms for bait.
examples.zh: 出去钓鱼前，他挖出一些虫子当饵。

examples.en: Using this as a bait?
examples.zh: 用这个当诱饵啊？

bald.definition:
v. grow bald; lose hair on one's head
s. with no effort to conceal
s. lacking hair on all or most of the scalp
s. without the natural or usual covering
bald.translation: a. 秃头的, 光秃的, 单调的, 赤裸的\nvi. 变秃

examples.en: He's a quiet man, a little bald on top.
examples.zh: 他是个很安静的人，头顶有点秃。

examples.en: Don't worry too much, or you'll go bald.
examples.zh: 别太操心了，不然会掉头发的。

examples.en: I don't understand why he goes to the barber's, as he is bald.
examples.zh: 我不明白为什么他全秃还要去理发店。

bane.definition: n. something causing misery or death
bane.translation: n. 祸根, 毒药, 灭亡的原因, 灭亡\n[医] 毒物, 毒, 毒药

examples.en: This cat is the bane of my life.
Boredom is the bane of my existence.
Mosquitoes are the bane of my existence.

barb.definition: n. the pointed part of barbed wire\nn. a subsidiary point facing opposite from the main point that makes an arrowhead or spear hard to remove\nn. one of the parallel filaments projecting from the main shaft of a feather
barb.translation: n. 倒钩\nvt. 装倒钩于

examples.en: My coat got caught on a barb on the barbed wire.
He couldn't come up with a pithy barb on the spot.
The barb on fishhooks make them difficult to remove.

baron.definition: n. a nobleman (in various countries) of varying rank\nn. a British peer of the lowest rank\nn. a very wealthy or powerful businessman
baron.translation: n. 男爵\n[法] 男爵, 贵族, 大王

examples.en: While the rest of us toil, the robber barons eat from gilt tableware.
examples.zh: 当我们其他人辛苦工作时，强盗贵族却用镀金餐具吃饭。

examples.en: While the rest of us work hard, the robber barons eat with gilded utensils.
examples.zh: 当我们其他人辛苦工作时，强盗贵族却用镀金餐具吃饭。

barren.definition: n. an uninhabited wilderness that is worthless for cultivation\ns. not bearing offspring\ns. completely wanting or lacking
barren.translation: a. 不育的, 贫瘠的\nn. 荒地

examples.en: The trees are barren or bear only small fruit.
This part of Algeria is extremely hot and barren.
It seems as if the barren fields are shivering with cold.

bass.definition:
n. the lowest part of the musical range
n. the lowest part in polyphonic music
n. an adult male singer with the lowest voice
n. the lowest adult male singing voice
bass.translation: n. 低沉的声音, 男低音, 椴树\na. 低音的

examples.en: He can't even tell a treble clef from a bass clef.
examples.zh: 他连高音谱号和低音谱号都分不清。

bazaar.definition: n. a shop where a variety of goods are sold\nn. a street of small shops (especially in Orient)\nn. a sale of miscellany; often for charity
bazaar.translation: n. 集市, 市场, 义卖市场

examples.en: The Grand Bazaar in Istanbul is an explosion of colors.
Do you know how can I go to the grand bazaar?
The bazaar is closed, the public square is vacant.

beckon.definition: v. signal with the hands or nod\nv. appear inviting\nv. summon with a wave, nod, or some other gesture
beckon.translation: v. 招手示意, 召唤, 吸引\nn. 表召唤的点头(或手势)

examples.en: She beckoned me to come in.
examples.zh: 她招呼我进来。

befriend.translation: vt. 待人如友, 扶助

examples.en: You must befriend the bacteria that live in your gut.
So as to compensate for myself, I befriend the conventional.
Befriend Tom, and you’ll soon regret it.

benevolent.definition: a. intending or showing kindness\ns. generous in providing aid to others
benevolent.translation: a. 善意的, 慈善的

examples.en: Why would a benevolent god allow Hell to exist?
I think most of them are benevolent but misguided.
The treatment was made possible by a benevolent donor.

benign.definition: a. not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor)\na. pleasant and beneficial in nature or influence\ns. kindness of disposition or manner
benign.translation: a. 善良的, 良性的\n[医] 良性的

examples.en: There are various kinds of tumour, both benign and malignant.
A wart is a generally benign and slightly contagious infection.
Tom has a benign tumor in his left lung.

beset.definition: v. assail or attack on all sides: "The zebra was beset by leopards"
beset.translation: vt. 围绕, 使苦恼, 镶嵌

examples.en: The company is still beset by technical challenges.
Young people fled cities beset by terrorism, the economic crisis and drugs.
The problem was beset with difficulties.

bizarre.definition: s. conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual

examples.en: That building's facade is bizarre. No idea what the architect was thinking.
examples.zh: 这座大楼的外观很奇怪，不知道设计师是怎么想的。

examples.en: What a bizarre tale!
examples.zh: 多么荒唐的故事！

examples.en: What a bizarre story!
examples.zh: 多么荒唐的故事！

bland.definition: s. lacking taste or flavor or tang\ns. lacking stimulating characteristics; uninteresting
bland.translation: a. 温和的, 乏味的, 冷漠的\n[医] 温和的, 淡的

examples.en: Life would become bland without you.
examples.zh: 如果没有你，我的人生就会变得空白一片。

examples.en: This novel is too bland.
examples.zh: 这本小说太乏味了。

blasphemy.definition: n. blasphemous language (expressing disrespect for God or for something sacred)
blasphemy.translation: n. 亵渎神明, 亵渎神明的言词\n[法] 冒秽罪, 侮辱, 亵秽

examples.en: "Novels? I hate novels." Oh muse, forgive her blasphemy.
examples.zh: 「小说啊？我就讨厌看小说。」天哪，请原谅她的亵渎行为。

examples.en: Me? Encourage you to work? Blasphemy!
examples.zh: 我？鼓励你去工作？不可能！

examples.en: Blasphemy is a victimless crime.
examples.zh: 亵渎是没有受害者的犯罪。

blatant.definition: s. without any attempt at concealment; completely obvious\ns. conspicuously and offensively loud; given to vehement outcry
blatant.translation: a. 喧嚣的, 吵闹的, 俗丽的, 炫耀的

examples.en: I am offended by your blatant disregard for my feelings.
What he didn't expect was blatant hatred and callous violence.
What Tom said about me is a blatant lie.

bleak.translation: a. 萧瑟的, 荒凉的, 阴冷的

examples.en: Some experts provided a bleak assessment of Algeria's current situation.
It's not an unremittingly bleak book. It's often funny – bitterly funny.
Where do you go when days are bleak?

blizzard.definition: n. a storm with widespread snowfall accompanied by strong winds
blizzard.translation: n. 大风雪, 暴风雪

examples.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.
examples.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

examples.en: Our journey went smoothly until we ran into a blizzard.
examples.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

examples.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
examples.zh: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。

blot.definition: n. an act that brings discredit to the person who does it\nv. dry (ink) with blotting paper
blot.translation: n. 污点, 墨水渍\nvt. 乱涂, 使模糊, 吸干\nvi. 弄上墨渍, 吸墨水

examples.en: The whole place was simply blotted out with the snow.
examples.zh: 整个地方完全地被雪遮盖住了。

examples.en: This blot can't be wiped out.
examples.zh: 这污点擦不掉。

bluff.definition:
n. a high steep bank (usually formed by river erosion)
n. pretense that your position is stronger than it really is
n. the act of bluffing in poker; deception by a false show of confidence in the strength of your cards
v. deceive an opponent by a bold bet on an inferior hand with the result that the opponent withdraws a winning hand
bluff.translation: n. 断崖, 绝壁, 吓唬\na. 直率的\nv. 吓唬, 欺骗

examples.en: Tom is bluffing.
examples.zh: 汤姆在虚张声势。

blunder.translation: n. 大错, 大失策\nvi. 失策, 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯错\nvt. 做错

examples.en: The U.S. Constitution is a blunder of a document.
He pleaded for me when I made a blunder.
I am not responsible to you for my blunder.

blunt.definition:
v. make less intense
v. make less sharp
s. having a broad or rounded end
s. used of a knife or other blade; not sharp
blunt.translation: a. 钝的, 坦率的, 麻痹的

examples.en: My sword may be blunt, but that's more than enough for someone like you.
examples.zh: 我的剑虽然是钝的，但应付你的话是绰绰有余的。

examples.en: The knife was so blunt that I could not cut the meat with it and I resorted to my pocket knife.
examples.zh: 那把刀太钝了，根本切不动肉，我只好拿出我的小刀。

bog.definition: n. wet spongy ground of decomposing vegetation; has poorer drainage than a swamp; soil is unfit for cultivation but can be cut and dried and used for fuel
bog.translation: n. 沼泽\nvt. 使陷于泥沼\nvi. 陷于泥沼

examples.en: Where's the bog?
examples.zh: 厕所在哪？

bolster.definition: n. a pillow that is often put across a bed underneath the regular pillows\nv. support and strengthen\nv. prop up with a pillow or bolster
bolster.translation: n. 支持, 长枕\nvt. 支持, 支撑

examples.en: Narcissists may use others to bolster their own self-esteem and self-worth.
You need some evidence to bolster your claim.
The new evidence will bolster your case.

bombard.definition: v. throw bombs at or attack with bombs\nv. address with continuously or persistently, as if with a barrage\nv. direct high energy particles or radiation against
bombard.translation: vt. 炮击, 攻击, 轰击\nn. 射石炮

examples.en: The teacher began to bombard me with questions.
The army responded in kind, bombarding every single rebel stronghold.
Ziri sat next to Rima and started bombarding her with questions.

bondage.definition: n. the state of being under the control of a force or influence or abstract power\nn. the state of being under the control of another person\nn. sexual practice that involves physically restraining (by cords or handcuffs) one of the partners
bondage.translation: n. 奴役, 束缚\n[法] 束缚, 监禁, 奴隶

examples.en: I guess she's into bondage and domination.
examples.zh: 我想她想要的是束缚与支配。

examples.en: He liberated the people from bondage.
examples.zh: 他让人们摆脱了奴役。

bonfire.definition: n. a large outdoor fire that is lighted as a signal or in celebration

examples.en: Would you like to join me for a beach bonfire?
Tom and his friends made a bonfire on the beach.
Gabriel and his friends organized a bonfire near the lake.

botanical.definition: n. a drug made from part of a plant (as the bark or root or leaves)
botanical.translation: a. 植物学的\nn. 植物性药材

examples.en: We found many strange plants in a botanical garden.
examples.zh: 我们在一家植物园里找到了许多稀奇古怪的植物。

examples.en: One of many botanical debates regards the question of the pecan — To me, it's a fruit, and not a nut.
examples.zh: 植物学界众多争论之一是关于山核桃的问题——在我看来，它是水果，而不是坚果。

bounty.definition: n. payment or reward (especially from a government) for acts such as catching criminals or killing predatory animals or enlisting in the military\nn. generosity evidenced by a willingness to give freely\nn. a ship of the British navy; in 1789 part of the crew mutinied against their commander William Bligh and set him afloat in an open boat
bounty.translation: n. 慷慨, 宽大, 礼物\n[经] 奖励金, 补贴

examples.en: Beauty without bounty avails naught.
examples.zh: 没有仁爱的美丽毫无用处

bout.definition: n. a period of illness\nn. a contest or fight (especially between boxers or wrestlers)
bout.translation: n. 一回, 回合, 较量\n[医] 发作

examples.en: Tom's bout with diarrhea was foreordained due to Mary's refusal to clean any cookware.
examples.zh: 玛丽拒绝洗炊具，汤姆注定会闹肚子。

brace.definition:
n. a support that steadies or strengthens something else
n. either of two punctuation marks ({ or }) used to enclose textual material
n. a rope on a square-rigged ship that is used to swing a yard about and secure it
n. elastic straps that hold trousers up (usually used in the plural)
brace.translation:
n. 支柱, 曲柄, 支撑, 一对
vt. 紧缚, 支撑, 激励
vi. 打起精神
[计] 花括号

examples.en: Yanni brought his mother a back brace from the UK.
He has a brace on his right leg.
Tom has a brace on his right leg.

bravo.definition: n. a cry of approval as from an audience at the end of great performance\nv. applaud with shouts of `bravo' or `brava'
bravo.translation: n. 亡命徒, 喝彩\ninterj. 好啊\nvt. 喝彩

examples.en: The audience shouted "Bravo!" for at least a full minute.
Sami went from a little nerdy guy to a Johnny Bravo.
There were many journalists who praised Ogawa with, "bravo, good show!"

brew.definition: n. drink made by steeping and boiling and fermenting rather than distilling\nv. prepare by brewing\nv. sit or let sit in boiling water so as to extract the flavor
brew.translation: n. 酿造酒, 酝酿\nv. 酿造, 酝酿

examples.en: When you travel, you've got to try the local brew.
That home brew of Tom's packs a punch.
First I'll have my cup of brew, alright?

brim.definition:
n. the top edge of a vessel or other container
n. a circular projection that sticks outward from the crown of a hat
v. be completely full
v. fill as much as possible
brim.translation: n. 边, 边缘, (河)边\nvt. 注满, 使满溢\nvi. 满溢

examples.en: His eyes were brimming over with tears.
examples.zh: 他热泪盈眶。

examples.en: Two women wielding giant spatulas continuously stir a brimming wok of shredded beef simmering in curry sauce.
examples.zh: 两名女子挥舞著巨大的锅铲，不停地翻炒著盛满咖哩酱汁的牛肉丝。

brink.definition: n. a region marking a boundary\nn. the edge of a steep place

examples.en: First Contact became humanity's salvation as it was at the brink of self-destruction.
examples.zh: 在人类自我毁灭的边缘，第一次接触成了福音。

examples.en: Due to total Russification in Belarus, the Belarusian language is on the brink of extinction.
examples.zh: 由于白俄罗斯完全地俄罗斯化，白俄罗斯语在绝灭的边缘。

bristle.definition:
n. a stiff fiber (coarse hair or filament); natural or synthetic
n. a stiff hair
v. rise up as in fear
v. have or be thickly covered with or as if with bristles
bristle.translation: n. 刚毛, 猪鬃\nvi. 直立, 发怒, 充满\nvt. 使直立

examples.en: This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.
examples.zh: 这个系统存在着许多缺陷和不尽完善的地方。

examples.en: The dog's hair bristled up with anger.
examples.zh: 狗生气地炸毛了。

examples.en: New York bristles with towering buildings.
examples.zh: 纽约充满著高楼大厦。

brooch.definition: n. a decorative pin worn by women\nv. fasten with or as if with a brooch

examples.en: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
examples.zh: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。

examples.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.
examples.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。

buckle.definition: n. fastener that fastens together two ends of a belt or strap; often has loose prong\nv. fasten with a buckle or buckles\nv. fold or collapse
buckle.translation: n. 皮带扣, 扣子\nvt. 扣住, 使弯曲\nvi. 扣住, 变弯曲, 屈服

examples.en: It's the law: always buckle your safety belt in cars and airplanes.
examples.zh: 法律规定，在车辆和飞机上，一定要扣上安全带。

examples.en: The roof of the house suddenly buckled.
examples.zh: 屋顶突然崩塌了。

budding.definition: n. reproduction of some unicellular organisms (such as yeasts) by growth and specialization followed by the separation by constriction of a part of the parent\ns. beginning to develop
budding.translation: a. 萌芽的, 发育期的, 初露头角的\nn. 发芽

examples.en: The budding of the peach tree is very beautiful.
examples.zh: 正在开花桃树很美。

buffet.definition:
n. a piece of furniture that stands at the side of a dining room; has shelves and drawers
n. a meal set out on a buffet at which guests help themselves
v. strike against forcefully
v. strike, beat repeatedly
buffet.translation: n. 自助餐, 小卖部, 碗橱, 殴打, 冲击\nvt. 连续打, 冲击, 搏斗\nvi. 奋斗

examples.en: There are a lot of people so today we've gone for buffet style.
examples.zh: 因为人很多，今天我们会采取自助餐的形式。

examples.en: Two for the lunch buffet, please.
examples.zh: 两人份自助午餐，谢谢。

examples.en: Where is the buffet restaurant?
examples.zh: 自助餐厅在哪里？

bulky.definition: s. of large size for its weight
bulky.translation: a. 庞大的\n[机] 庞大, 笨重

examples.en: This box is too bulky to carry.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太笨重了无法携带。

examples.en: I'm beginning to stop seeing people wearing bulky glasses like that of the bottom of a milk bottle.
examples.zh: 镜片像牛奶瓶底一样厚的那种眼镜，我不太看到有人戴了。

bunk.definition:
n. a long trough for feeding cattle
n. a rough bed (as at a campsite)
n. unacceptable behavior (especially ludicrously false statements)
v. provide with a bunk
bunk.translation: n. 铺位, 废话, 逃走\nvi. 逃跑, 睡在铺上\nvt. 提供铺位

examples.en: Mary is on her bunk reading.
examples.zh: 玛丽在她的床位上读书。

buoyant.definition: s. tending to float on a liquid or rise in air or gas\ns. characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness
buoyant.translation: a. 有浮力的, 心情愉快的\n[经] 降而复升的, 保持高价的, 遂之而升的

examples.en: How can ships be buoyant when not even rocks are?
Salt water is more buoyant than fresh water.
She was in a buoyant mood.

burgundy.definition: n. red table wine from the Burgundy region of France (or any similar wine made elsewhere)\nn. a dark purplish-red to blackish-red color
burgundy.translation: n. 勃艮第(法国一地区), 勃艮第葡萄酒

examples.en: Does this burgundy Henley shirt come in small?
Like most white Burgundy wine, it is made entirely from the Chardonnay grape.
Colette was born in Burgundy in 1873.

burrow.definition: n. a hole made by an animal, usually for shelter\nv. move through by or as by digging
burrow.translation: n. 洞穴, 藏身处\nvi. 掘洞穴, 躲藏\nvt. 掘, 打洞

examples.en: The dung beetle dug a burrow in the soft sand.
A hamster can store 5 kg of food in its burrow.
The dung beetle took the dung ball to its burrow.

bust.definition: n. a sculpture of the head and shoulders of a person\nn. an occasion for excessive eating or drinking
bust.translation:
n. 半身像, 胸部, 失败, 殴打
vt. 使爆裂, 使破产
vi. 爆裂, 破产
[计] 操作错

examples.en: Who hasn't busted their back on deadline day?
examples.zh: 谁没有在截稿日拼过命？

bygone.definition: n. past events to be put aside\ns. well in the past; former
bygone.translation: n. 过去的事, 往事\na. 过去的

examples.en: Let bygones be bygones.
examples.zh: 既往不咎。

bypass.definition: n. a surgically created shunt (usually around a damaged part)\nv. avoid something unpleasant or laborious
bypass.translation: n. 旁路\nvt. 省略, 绕过, 忽视, 回避

examples.en: A bypass allows more blood to flow to the heart.
Fish ladders help salmon bypass man-made obstacles, such as dams.
AI is best used to enhance learning rather than bypass it.

bail.definition:
n. (criminal law) money that must be forfeited by the bondsman if an accused person fails to appear in court for trial
n. the legal system that allows an accused person to be temporarily released from custody (usually on condition that a sum of money guarantees their appearance at trial)
v. release after a security has been paid
v. deliver something in trust to somebody for a special purpose and for a limited period
bail.translation: n. 保释, 拎环, 杓, 栅栏\nvt. 保释, 舀水

examples.en: What will I get in return for your friend's bail?
Tom is stuck in jail because he can't afford bail.
Tom has been arrested and is being held without bail.

bishop.definition: n. a senior member of the Christian clergy having spiritual and administrative authority; appointed in Christian churches to oversee priests or ministers; considered in some churches to be successors of the twelve Apostles of Christ\nn. port wine mulled with oranges and cloves\nn. (chess) a piece that can be moved diagonally over unoccupied squares of the same color
bishop.translation: n. 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒

examples.en: I think this bishop is a wolf in sheep's clothing.
A bishop can never end up on an opposite-colored square.
A bishop can never end up on an opposite-coloured square.

bouquet.definition: n. an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present\nn. a pleasingly sweet olfactory property
bouquet.translation: n. 花束\n[医] 丛, 酒香, 末梢分极

examples.en: She held a large bouquet of artificial flowers in her hands.
examples.zh: 她手里拿著一大束假花。

examples.en: Sami put Layla's bouquet in his room.
examples.zh: 萨米将莱拉的花束放在了他的房间里。

bracelet.definition: n. jewelry worn around the wrist for decoration
bracelet.translation: n. 手镯\n[医] 手镯, 腕带, 腕纹(掌侧横列腕部的线纹)

examples.en: "Bracelet" means the same thing in English that it does in French.
examples.zh: 英文"Bracelet"在法文的意思是相同的。

examples.en: "Bracelet" is the same in French.
examples.zh: 英文"Bracelet"在法文的意思是相同的。

broker.translation: n. 掮客, 经纪人\n[经] 经纪人, 掮客

examples.en: I hear you've already contacted the broker.
examples.zh: 听说您已经跟中介公司联系过了。

backbone.definition: n. fortitude and determination\nn. the part of a network that connects other networks together
backbone.translation: n. 脊椎, 志气, 骨干, 支柱\n[计] 主干网, 主干网点

examples.en: This makes oil and gas the backbone of Algeria's economy.
Oil and gas are the backbone of Algeria's economy.
Kelp is the backbone of Monterey Bay coastal ecology.

basement.definition: n. the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage\nn. the ground floor facade or interior in Renaissance architecture
basement.translation: n. 地下室, 墙脚\n[化] 地下室

examples.en: The police think the burglar entered through a basement window.
examples.zh: 警察认为窃贼从地下室窗口进入。

examples.en: I know I left it somewhere down here in the basement.
examples.zh: 我知道我把它放在地下室的某个地方了。

examples.en: They cleaned everything, from the basement to the attic.
examples.zh: 他们从地下室到阁楼都打扫了。

beacon.definition:
n. a fire (usually on a hill or tower) that can be seen from a distance
n. a tower with a light that gives warning of shoals to passing ships
v. shine like a beacon
v. guide with a beacon
beacon.translation: n. 烽火, 灯塔\nv. 照亮

examples.en: In the 1970s, Algeria was considered a beacon of prosperity.
You are a beacon of calm amidst the chaos.
Jane Goodall's legacy is a beacon of hope for our planet.

bead.definition:
n. a small ball with a hole through the middle
v. form into beads, as of water or sweat, for example
v. decorate by sewing beads onto
v. string together like beads
bead.translation:
n. 珠子, 滴
vt. 用珠装饰
vi. 形成珠
[计] 珠

examples.en: Achieving a nice weld bead is not within everyone's reach!
He drew a bead on a stag at bay.
A bead of sweat started forming on his brow.

beak.definition:
n. beaklike mouth of animals other than birds (e.g., turtles)
n. horny projecting mouth of a bird
n. a beaklike, tapering tip on certain plant structures
n. informal terms for the nose
beak.translation: n. 鸟嘴, 喙\n[医] 嘴, 喙

examples.en: A pelican's beak is made that way for a reason.
A pelican can fit a lot of fish in its beak.
They have a bent nose, like the beak of a crow.

beetle.definition:
n. insect having biting mouthparts and front wings modified to form horny covers overlying the membranous rear wings
v. fly or go in a manner resembling a beetle
v. beat with a beetle
s. jutting or overhanging
beetle.translation: n. 甲虫, 大槌\nvi. 快速移动\nvt. 捶

examples.en: Yanni saw his son playing with a June beetle.
examples.zh: 雅尼看到儿子在玩一只金龟子。

examples.en: June beetle grubs feed on plant roots.
examples.zh: 六月金龟子的幼虫以植物根部为食。

examples.en: Dung beetles are insects.
examples.zh: 虼螂是昆虫。

benchmark.definition: n. a standard by which something can be measured or judged\nn. a surveyor's mark on a permanent object of predetermined position and elevation used as a reference point

examples.en: She thinks that happiness and health should be the benchmarks for success.
examples.zh: 她认为幸福与健康才是衡量成功的标准。

bigot.definition: n. a prejudiced person who is intolerant of any opinions differing from his own
bigot.translation: n. 盲从者, 偏执的人

examples.en: It is useless to reason with a bigot.
That man is just a bigot.
Bigots are incapable of discriminating, since they lump individuals into homogeneous groupings.

bin.definition: n. a container; usually has a lid\nn. the quantity contained in a bin\nv. store in bins
bin.translation: n. (贮存谷物等的)容器, 箱子\n[计] 二进制, 商业信息网

examples.en: Hey, Tom, can we get two bins of lettuce?
examples.zh: 嘿，汤姆，我们可以买两箱生菜吗？

examples.en: Toss it into the rubbish bin.
examples.zh: 给丢到垃圾桶里去。

examples.en: Bung it in the bin.
examples.zh: 给丢到垃圾桶里去。

biochemistry.definition: n. the organic chemistry of compounds and processes occurring in organisms; the effort to understand biology within the context of chemistry
biochemistry.translation: n. 生物化学\n[化] 生物化学; 生化

examples.en: My dream is to study Biochemistry at the University of Oxford.
The biochemistry test was a cinch.
I have little knowledge of biochemistry.

bitmap.definition: n. an image represented as a two dimensional array of brightness values for pixels

bladder.definition: n. a distensible membranous sac (usually containing liquid or gas)\nn. a bag that fills with air
bladder.translation: n. 膀胱, 囊\n[医] 囊, 膀胱

examples.en: Mary pressed on my bladder to see if I'd leak.
My small bladder has me constantly running to the bathroom.
Have you ever been treated for a bladder infection?

bleach.definition:
n. the whiteness that results from removing the color from something
n. the act of whitening something by bleaching it (exposing it to sunlight or using a chemical bleaching agent)
v. remove color from
v. make whiter or lighter
bleach.translation: vt. 漂白\nvi. 变白\nn. 漂白, 漂白剂

examples.en: Don't mix ammonia and bleach together.
examples.zh: 别把氨水和漂白剂混在一起。

blister.definition:
n. a flaw on a surface resulting when an applied substance does not adhere (as an air bubble in a coat of paint)
n. (botany) a swelling on a plant similar to that on the skin
n. (pathology) an elevation of the skin filled with serous fluid
v. get blistered

examples.en: I've got blisters on my feet.
examples.zh: 我的脚起水泡了。

blob.translation: n. 一滴, 小斑点\nvt. 溅污

examples.en: Wait a minute. Did you call me "blob"?
Evolve or become a blob of cancer.
The first pancake is always a blob.

blonde.definition: n a person with fair skin and hair\nn a light grayish yellow to near white\na being or having light colored skin and hair and usually blue or grey eyes
blonde.translation: a. (头发)亚麻色的, 淡色的, 白肤金发碧眼的, 白里透红的, 白皙的, 淡黄色的\nn. 肤色白皙的金发女人

examples.en: I want to find a blonde, blue-eyed European woman.
examples.zh: 他想找一位金发碧眼的欧洲女人。

examples.en: She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and blue eyes.
examples.zh: 她是个美丽的女孩，有著金色头发和蓝色眼睛。

examples.en: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
examples.zh: 她有著一头金发，瘦高的身材。

blues.definition: n. a type of folksong that originated among Black Americans at the beginning of the 20th century; has a melancholy sound from repeated use of blue notes\nn. a state of depression
blues.translation: n. 勃鲁斯乐曲, (非正式)伤感的, 伤心的\n[医] 忧闷, 沮丧

examples.en: I have the blues today.
examples.zh: 我今天心情不太好。

examples.en: The poor sales during that Holiday season served as the final nail in the coffin for Boar Corporation.
examples.zh: 那个假期销售业绩不佳，为博尔公司敲下了最后一根棺材钉。

bodyguard.definition: n. someone who escorts and protects a prominent person\nn. a group of men who escort and protect some important person

examples.en: The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.
examples.zh: 保镖戴着耳机。

bookmark.definition: n. a marker (a piece of paper or ribbon) placed between the pages of a book to mark the reader's place

examples.en: Bookmark this site.
examples.zh: 将此网站存入书签。

boutique.definition: n. a shop that sells women's clothes and jewelry
boutique.translation: n. 专卖流行衣服的小商店

examples.en: The clothes at this boutique are particularly expensive.
examples.zh: 这家精品店的服装卖得很贵.

brawl.definition: n. a noisy fight in a crowd\nv. to quarrel noisily, angrily or disruptively
brawl.translation: n. 争吵\nvi. 争吵, 哗哗地流水

examples.en: Tom lost a couple of teeth in the brawl.
A brawl broke out between Dan and a co-worker.
Sami and Farid had a brawl right before Christmas.

bruise.definition:
n. an injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration
v. injure the underlying soft tissue or bone of
v. break up into small pieces for food preparation
v. damage (plant tissue) by abrasion or pressure
bruise.translation: n. 青肿, 挫伤, 擦伤\nvi. 受伤, 擦伤\nvt. 使受伤, 研碎

examples.en: The skin of peaches bruises easily.
examples.zh: 桃子的皮很容易破。

buffalo.definition: n. a city on Lake Erie in western New York (near Niagara Falls)\nn. meat from an American bison\nv. intimidate or overawe

examples.en: The woman has suffered from a collapse, because she ate meat from a water buffalo.
examples.zh: 女人食用水牛肉导致晕厥。

bulb.definition:
n. a modified bud consisting of a thickened globular underground stem serving as a reproductive structure
n. a rounded part of a cylindrical instrument (usually at one end)
n. anything with a round shape resembling a teardrop
n. a rounded dilation or expansion in a canal or vessel or organ
bulb.translation: n. 球茎, 电灯泡\n[医] 球, 鳞茎, 球茎

examples.en: Can you change the kitchen light bulb before you leave?
examples.zh: 您离开前能帮忙换一下厨房的灯泡吗？

examples.en: Yanni put the light bulb in a box.
examples.zh: 雅尼将灯泡放入箱子。

examples.en: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
examples.zh: 爱迪生发明了电灯炮。

burgeon.translation: n. 芽, 嫩枝\nv. 萌芽, 发芽

examples.en: Back in the 1970s, Matoub was already a burgeoning start.
Algeria needs raw materials for its burgeoning industry.
The empire expanded eastward, in search of resources for its burgeoning textile industry.

burial.definition: n. the ritual placing of a corpse in a grave
burial.translation: n. 埋葬, 葬礼\n[法] 埋葬, 葬礼

examples.en: See to it that Ziri receives a proper Muslim burial.
The place of his death and burial is, however, unknown.
The Takamatsuzuka burial mound is located in Asukamura, Nara prefecture.

buzz.definition:
n. sound of rapid vibration
n. a confusion of activity and gossip
v. make a buzzing sound
v. fly low
buzz.translation: n. 嗡嗡声, 流言\nvi. 发出嗡嗡声, 说闲话\nvt. 使嗡嗡叫, 散布

examples.en: I'm getting a bit of a nicotine buzz.
examples.zh: 我有点醉烟。

examples.en: The buzzing of the bees makes me a little nervous.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂的嗡嗡让我紧张一点。

examples.en: Hearing that a transfer student was coming, the class buzzed with excitement.
examples.zh: 听说要来一个转校生之后，全班都乱哄哄地活跃起来。

browser.definition: n. a viewer who looks around casually without seeking anything in particular\nn. a program used to view HTML documents
browser.translation: n. 吃嫩叶的动物, 浏览书本的人\n[计] 浏览程序

examples.en: What web browser do you like the most?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个网络浏览器？

examples.en: The browser is running really slowly.
examples.zh: 浏览器跑得超级慢。

examples.en: Which browser do you use?
examples.zh: 你用哪一个浏览器？

bibliography.definition: n. a list of writings with time and place of publication (such as the writings of a single author or the works referred to in preparing a document etc.)
bibliography.translation: n. 参考书目\n[计] 书目; 文献目录

examples.en: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.
examples.zh: 把书目提要交上。

examples.en: I will note down the recommended bibliography on the list and look for them next time I come to the library.
examples.zh: 我会将推荐的书目记在清单上，下次来图书馆时看。

blossom.definition: v. develop or come to a promising stage
blossom.translation: n. 花, 花开的状态, 兴旺期\nvi. 开花, 兴旺, 发展

examples.en: The apple tree has a beautiful blossom.
examples.zh: 苹果树上挂着美丽的花朵。

examples.en: The blossoms will be out in a few days.
examples.zh: 过两三天就要开花了。

examples.en: Right now is the time of year to see the cherry blossoms.
examples.zh: 现在是看樱桃树的期间。

blender.definition: n. an electrically powered mixer with whirling blades that mix or chop or liquefy foods
blender.translation: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌器\n[化] 掺合机; 捏和机; 混合机; 搅拌机; 搅切器; 捣碎器

examples.en: Food processors tend to be shorter and wider than blenders.
examples.zh: 食物调理机往往比搅拌机短和宽。

examples.en: Blenders are nice for people who really like smoothies.
examples.zh: 搅拌机对真的喜欢冰沙的人来说很不错。

battalion.definition: n. an army unit usually consisting of a headquarters and three or more companies\nn. a large indefinite number
battalion.translation: n. 营, 军队, 集团

examples.en: He rose in rank to become commander of the battalion.
The Ukrainian army uses paramilitary groups like the Azov Battalion.
The officers in our battalion were quite young.

barley.definition: n. a grain of barley\nn. cultivated since prehistoric times; grown for forage and grain

examples.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
examples.zh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

beetroot.definition: n. beet having a massively swollen red root; widely grown for human consumption

examples.en: Ziri found a raw piece of beetroot on the floor.
Beetroot was offered to Apollo in his temple at Delphi.
Her face went as red as a beetroot.

broccoli.definition: n. plant with dense clusters of tight green flower buds\nn. branched green undeveloped flower heads

examples.en: The broccoli is overcooked today — it's not very good.
examples.zh: 今天的西蓝花做过头了，不是很好吃。

examples.en: Broccoli is one of the healthiest vegetables.
examples.zh: 西蓝花是最健康的蔬菜之一。

examples.en: Tom added broccoli to the stew.
examples.zh: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。

badger.definition: n. sturdy carnivorous burrowing mammal with strong claws; widely distributed in the northern hemisphere\nv. persuade through constant efforts
badger.translation: n. 獾, 獾皮毛\nvt. 纠缠

examples.en: That's the badger!
examples.zh: 这是狗獾！

examples.en: The badger travels steadily, with its body very low and close to the ground; the marmot, especially when excited, gallops along, with undulatory movements of the body.
examples.zh: 獾行进时步伐稳定，身体压得很低、贴近地面；旱獭则尤其在兴奋时会疾奔，身体呈波浪状起伏摆动。

beaver.definition:
n. the soft brown fur of the beaver
n. a full beard
n. a movable piece of armor on a medieval helmet used to protect the lower face
n. a hat made with the fur of a beaver (or similar material)
beaver.translation: n. 海狸(毛皮)\n[机] 轻型及中型飞机加油

examples.en: Beavers may be considered as the busiest mammals on Earth.
examples.zh: 海狸可能被认为是地球上最忙碌的哺乳动物。

banjo.definition: n. a stringed instrument of the guitar family that has long neck and circular body

examples.en: I bought Tom a banjo for Christmas.
examples.zh: 我给汤姆买了把斑卓琴作圣诞礼物。

bachelor.definition: n. a man who has never been married\nv. lead a bachelor's existence
bachelor.translation: n. 单身汉, 学士\n[法] 学士, 单身汉

examples.en: What's the premise of the TV show "The Bachelor"?
examples.zh: 《单身汉》这个电视节目的基本设定是什么？

examples.en: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.
examples.zh: 汤姆终身未娶。

examples.en: I know Tom is a bachelor.
examples.zh: 我知道汤姆是单身。

bang.definition:
n. a sudden very loud noise
n. a border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead
n. the swift release of a store of affective force
v. to produce a sharp often metallic explosive or percussive sound
bang.translation:
n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海
v. 发巨响, 重击
adv. 砰然地, 突然巨响地, 直接地
[计] 撞击符

examples.en: She banged the table with her fist.
examples.zh: 她用拳头拍了桌子。

examples.en: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛莉的小儿子喜欢坐在厨房地板上敲打锅碗瓢盆。

examples.en: I'd love to be able to tell the lady who cuts my hair that I don’t like bangs.
examples.zh: 我很想告诉给我理发的女士我不喜欢留刘海。

beloved.definition: n. a beloved person; used as terms of endearment\ns. dearly loved
beloved.translation: a. 心爱的\nn. 心爱的人

examples.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, chosen out of thousands.
examples.zh: 我所爱的是白皙红润，千里挑一的。

examples.en: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
examples.zh: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。

examples.en: He lost his most beloved son.
examples.zh: 他失去了最爱的儿子。

biological.definition: a. pertaining to biology or to life and living things\na. of parents and children; related by blood
biological.translation: a. 生物学的\n[医] 生物学的

examples.en: As soon as we are born, the world gets to work on us and transforms us from merely biological into social units.
examples.zh: 我们一出生在这个世界上，就会开始受到周遭环境的影响，从生物单位慢慢进化成社会单位。

butterfly.definition:
n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings
n. a swimming stroke in which the arms are thrown forward together out of the water while the feet kick up and down
v. flutter like a butterfly
v. cut and spread open, as in preparation for cooking
butterfly.translation: n. 蝴蝶\n[医] 蝶式棉块, 翼形皮癣, 纸蝶

examples.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的寿命短。

examples.en: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.
examples.zh: 这种种类的蝴蝶已经绝种了。

examples.en: Is it a butterfly or a moth?
examples.zh: 这是一只蝴蝶还是一只飞蛾？

backup.definition: n. an accumulation caused by clogging or a stoppage\nn. (computer science) a copy of a file or directory on a separate storage device
backup.translation:
n. 倒车, 后退, 后援, 支持, 阻塞
vt. 做备份
a. 候补的, 支持的
[计] 备份; DOS外部命令:通常使用于将硬磁盘上指定的文件复制到软盘上

examples.en: Sami is the real Zorro and Farid is his backup.
I think that Tom is a pretty good backup singer.
I have a backup plan in case something goes wrong.

bakery.definition: n. a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold

examples.en: I'm going to the bakery now. Do you want anything?
examples.zh: 我现在要去面包店了。你想要什么吗？

examples.en: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.
examples.zh: 在面包房工作的姑娘很可爱。

examples.en: In U.S. bakeries, a "baker's dozen" is 13, not 12.
examples.zh: 在美国的面包店，"面包师傅的一打"是13，不是12。

banking.definition: n. engaging in the business of keeping money for savings and checking accounts or for exchange or for issuing loans and credit etc.\nn. transacting business with a bank; depositing or withdrawing funds or requesting a loan etc.
banking.translation: n. 银行业务\n[经] 银行业, 银行事务

examples.en: It's possible to branch out from computing to jobs in banking, accountancy and so on.
examples.zh: 有可能将电脑工作扩展到银行业务, 会计业务等等。

banknote.definition: n a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank)

examples.en: This is a forged banknote.
examples.zh: 这张钞票是假造的。

examples.en: This banknote is a forgery.
examples.zh: 这张钞票是假造的。

barge.definition: n. a flatbottom boat for carrying heavy loads (especially on canals)\nv. push one's way\nv. transport by barge on a body of water
barge.translation: n. 驳船\nvt. 用船运输\nvi. 蹒跚, 闯入

examples.en: This is my room. You can't just barge in here!
Why are you trying to barge into my life?
This is my room. You can't just barge in like that!

barometer.definition: n. an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure
barometer.translation: n. 气压计\n[化] 气压计

examples.en: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.
examples.zh: 气压计下降了 - 要下雨了。

examples.en: The barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, especially used to study climate and to determine altitudes.
examples.zh: 气压表是一种用来测量大气压力的仪器，主要用于研究气候和测量高度。
